tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya lo tsā ba chen po'i rnam par thar pa 'jam dpa'i dbyangs kyi yon tan rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ shrī sa skya lo tsā ba chen po'i rnam par thar pa 'jam dpa'i dbyangs kyi yon tan rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /thugs brtse ba chen pos skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /'jam dbyangs rigs kyi gangs ri las 'ongs 'gro kun dga' ba skyed la 'gro ba'i rgyun/ /bsod nams gser gyi sa gzhi rab 'khyil grags pa'i rba rlabs phyogs brgyar g.yo/ /rgyal ba'i ring lugs chu klung kun 'dus dge mtshan nor bu'i dpal yon can/ /skal bzang gdengs can dbang po'i bsti gnas sngon med chos kyi mtsho chen rgyal/ /yid 'ong mtshan dpe'i lang tsho cher rgyas mdzes sku mthong na mtha' yas 'gro kun dga' ba bskyed/ /nges don 'dom mkhas dri med tshangs dbyangs snyan pa'i gsung gis dpag yas bsod nams ye shes spel/ /dge legs kun 'byung thugs kyi nor bu sa gsum grags pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor mngon mtho ba'i/ /dpal ldan srid zhi'i 'dren pa bzang po 'jam dpal 'jam dbyangs 'jam pa'i rdo rje la btud de/ /rgyal ba kun dngos mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gnas lnga rig pa chos kyi rje/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal sa skya par grags kun dga'i mtshan can bla ma de'i/ /yon tan brjod pas deng sang 'di na dam pa'i skye bo kun phrel mod/ /bdag kyang dad dang gus pa chen pos mdzad pa'i cha tsam brjod la spro/ /zhes bya ba 'di la gsum ste/ sngon gyi rnam par thar pa mdor bstan/ da ltar gyi rnam par thar pa rgyas par bshad/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan bye brag tu bshad de don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rgya chen skyes rabs nor bu'i phreng ba ni/

/'jam dbyangs nyid las gzhan min de lta na'ang / /thun mong dag tu blo dman gdul bya'i ngor/ /sprul sku'i mdzad pa sna tshogs rim par ston/ /zhes te/ de yang / bdag cag rnams kyi 'dren pa dam pa/ khams gsum gyi mgon po/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas/ srid pa gsum gyi bla ma/ sku gsum gyi bdag nyid/ dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mig gcig pu/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na dpal sa skya pa zhes yongs su grags pa 'di ni nges pa kho nar bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu/ rnam pa thams cad pa'i mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid dang / mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po ro mnyam pa'i ye shes thams cad kyi sku mngon du mdzad nas/ zhing dag pa la lar ni dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo/ la lar ni 'khor/ la lar ni bsdu ba po la sogs pa rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi sku la drang ba'i don du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes rnam pa thams cad du ma bsgrib pa'i mtshan du brjod pa de nyid kyi sprul pa'i sku yin pa'i phyir/ de'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab cing dpe zla dang bral ba/ so so skye bo'i blo'i yul las 'das pas/ tshu rol mthong ba'i skye bos rtogs shing brjod par ga la nus/ de lta na'ang phyogs re tsam mtshon par 'dod pa dbang gis/ 'jam dpal gyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa dang / mi'i bdag po 'jam dpal grags pa la sogs pa'i mdzad pa'i cha dang / chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po khu dbon gyi rnam par thar pa las kyang che long tsam khong du chud par bya'o/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/ dang por zab gsal gnyis med 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bar du rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa'i zhabs/ /tha mar gnas lnga rig pa sa skya pa/ /bdag nyid chen po'i sngon gyi skyes rabs yin/

/gnyis pa da ltar gyi rnam thar rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ sku skye ba bzhes pa'i rnam thar dang / bzhes nas mchog gi spyod pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i rnam thar rol/ dang po ni/ 'chi med 'od gsal thig le'i rigs las 'khrungs/ /ma rig las 'khon tshogs gnyis dpung tshogs rgyas/ /mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal sa skya pa/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ chos sku 'od gsal zhing skye 'jigs dang bral ba mngon du mdzad cing / 'khor 'das gnyis 'dzin gyi 'gro 'ongs dang bral yang / zad mi shes pa'i smon lam dang thugs rje chen pos bskyed cing / gangs ri'i khrod kyi gdul bya skal ba dang ldan pa'i smon lam rnam par dag pa dang / legs byas dri ma med pas bskul nas/ rkang gnyis kyi gtso bo thub pa'i dbang po bzhin du gzigs pa rnam pa lngas gzigs nas/ thun mong gi gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngor sku skye ba bzhes pa'i rnam par thar pa phyogs tsam zhig brjod na/ thog mar bdag nyid chen po 'di gang du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i gnas ni/ 'di ltar dbus 'gyur gyi tshal/ byang chub kyi snying po rdo rje gdan nas byang gi phyogs su dpag tshad brgya bgrod pa'i gnas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag legs par sbyar ba'i skad du gsung ba'i yon tan rin po che'i 'byung khung / rgya gar gyi yul dang 'dabs 'byor du gnas pa/ 'phags pa'i gang zag nyon mongs pa'i bud shing zad cing / dben pa la gcig tu gzhol ba/ dbang po zhi ba rnams kyi bsti gnas/ lha rnams kyi dbang po mchod sbyin brgya pa'i gzhon pa sa srungs kyi bus nye bar bsten pa/ 'byung po'i bdag po dpal mgrin gtsug na zla ba'i gnas su gyur pa'i ri bo gangs can gyi 'dabs sprul pa'i rgyal po seng ge'i khri la gnas te dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos ston pa'i gnas chen sham+bha la dang nye ba'i chu bo sī ta'i lho phyogs kyi brgyud/

u ma'i bdag po'i gnas gzhan gnyis par grags shing / mi'am ci sprin gyi phreng ba can gyi nye bar bsten pa'i ti se'i gangs kyi shar phyogs/ kha ba can gyi brgyud du dam pa'i chos rgyas pa'i gzhi/ sprul pa'i rgyal pos nye bar bsgrubs pa/ shākya'i rgyal po'i gtsug lag khang lha sa dang / bsam yas kyi nub phyogs kyi ljongs/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgron ma bsil zer can babs pa ltar sa'i phyogs kun nas gsal zhing mdzes la/ 'gran zla med pa'i mkhas pa rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i mtshan ma dang ldan pa'i gtsang la stod grom pa dpal ldan sa skya zhes grags pa'i dgon sa nas/ dbang po'i phyogs su ha cang mi ring ba zhig bgrod pa'i nor 'dzin gyi mthil/ sman ljongs ku mu ta rnam par bzhad pa'i tshal ltar ches dkar zhing bsil ba'i chu rlung dri ma med pa'i rgyun 'bab pa/ phyi dang nang gi dpal 'byor du ma 'du ba'i bsti gnas/ dpal rtse gdong gi phun tshogs gling zhes bya ba'i khang bzang chen por/ yab gangs can gyi khrod na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba/ dri ma med pa'i 'od gsal 'chi med kyi rigs/ 'khon sa skya pa zhes skye dgu kun gyi rna ba'i rgyan du gyur pa'i yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bgrang ba las 'das pa rgyud ma nas brgyud mar byon pa'i gdung brgyud rnam par dag pa'i rigs su 'khrungs pa/ mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag nam mkha' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya ba yab chos la mkhas shing thugs dam zab mo la dus nam du yang mi g.yel bas/ rdo rje'i bsrung ma rnams dran du 'khol ba'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po de dang / yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i mtshan dang ldan zhing / rigs rus cho 'brang skyon med pa'i mi nyag gi rus tshan/ mdes za hor mo tshe brten zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gi zhabs tog la brtson zhing / byams pa dang snying rje che la/ lugs gnyis kyi bya ba la mkhas pa zhig gi sras su/

'khor gangs can gyi khrod kyi skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la dgongs nas sku skye ba bzhes pa yin te/ de yang bdag nyid chen po 'di'i yum rtse gdong bla brang du mi phebs tsam gyi nub gcig gi mnal lam du/ ri gcig la 'dzeg gin 'dug pas mun pa ches nas lam mi rnyed dam snyam pa la/ rum nas nyi zla gnyis bton nas phyogs thams cad gsal bar byas pa rmi zhing / yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa'i tshe na rtse gdong pa'i bla mtshor grags pa'i mtsho zhig yod pa cher rgyas pa dang / gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa 'bom ston ye shes rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i mnal lam du/ bla brang pa'i gsol zhing chen mo la/ yab gung na bzhugs nas sa bon 'debs shing / skye bo gzhan du ma dang bcas pas/ phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis byed pa dang / rmi ltas pa gzhan 'ga' zhig gi rmi lam du/ bla brang la sa dkar gsol ba dang / steng na dar 'phyar ba dang / mkha' la nyi zla shar ba la sogs pa byung zhing / khyad par yum la rmi ltas bzang po du ma dang / nyin par gyi tshe yang shes pa gsal zhing bde bas brgyan pa dang / lus ldang ba yang zhing zo mdog bde ba la sogs pa'i rtag khyad par can du ma byung bas/ rigs kyi sras skyes bu dam pa zhig 'byung bar mkhyen nas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu lus la yod pa lta bu'i 'du shes kyis/ gnod pa'i spyod lam thams cad spangs zhing / phan pa'i spyod lam dang / rim 'gro du ma bstan nas zla grangs thim ste/ 'phags pa'i yul na sna tshogs dbyig ces grags pa shing mo sbrul gyi lo chu stod zla ba'i nyer brgyad sbrul gyi nyi ma/ res gza' spen pa dang / skar ma lag la yod pa'i nyi ma snur smad kyi dus su/ bkra shis shing dge mtshan gyi ltas du ma dang bcas nas mngal gyi dri mas la gos bzhin du yum la gnod pa med par bde bar bltams shing / 'tsho ba'i ma ma du ma dang bcas pas rdzing na gnas pa'i pad+ma ltar du bskyed bsrings te/

gzhon nu de ni gzugs bzang zhing mdzes la/ lta na sdug pa zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar zhing zlum la gzengs mtho ba/ dpral ba'i dbyes che zhing spyan ut+pal ltar bkra ba/ kun gyis yid du 'ongs pa zhig go /cher 'khrungs nas kyang sku gsung thugs kyi rtsal stobs che zhing spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ bkur 'os kun la zhe sar mkhas pa/ mkhyen rab dang thugs rje tshad med pa dang ldan pa zhig 'khrungs so zhes thos so/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/ phun tshogs gnas dang skyon med rigs bzang dang / /kha na ma tho med pa'i yab dang yum/ /skal bar ldan pa'i 'khor tshogs la dgongs nas/ /zas gtsang sras bzhin dge mtshan bcas te bltams/ /gnyis pa sku skye ba bzhes nas mchog gi spyod pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i rnam thar la gnyis te/ rab tu ma byung bar gzhon nu'i sa la gnas pa'i rnam thar dang / rab tu byung nas bstan pa'i bya ba ji ltar mdzad pa'i rnam thar ro/ /dang po ni/ kun dga'i bzhin ldan rgyal sras gzhon nu'i sku/ /'khrungs ma thag nas mkhas pa'i mgon gyis bsngags/ /yon tan klog pa tshad med 'bras bur bcas/ /ngo mtshar skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang ldan/ /zhes te/ 'khrungs ma thag pa nas reg pa'i gnas mtha' dag la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab can/ shar mi nyag gi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po grags pa rdo rje zil gnon rtse na bzhugs pa/ sku la bsrung ba dang skyabs pa'i don du spyan drangs pas/ a rog khyed dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa ba zin a gsung zhing / sku 'phang du bzhes te/ rgyal ba'i thugs sras sngon sbyangs dge ba yis/ /yon tan thams cad 'bad med lhun gyis grub/ /chung ngu nyid nas dam pa'i spyod pa mdzad/ /bu chung 'phags pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod cing mtshan rdo rje rgyal sogs bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bar gsol te/ ljags la gur gum gyi dhiḥyig 'bri ba la sogs pa blo rno ba'i thabs kyi cho ga rnams mdzad ces thos la/

mtshan 'dogs pa'i tho rangs paṇ+ḍi ta de'i mnal lam du/ blo gros gter chen mi sad bang mdzod yin/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa sgra dbyangs kyi tshul du byung ba la sogs pa mtshan ltas khyad par can du ma byung ngo / /de nas mtshan ltas dang bstod pa'i tshig la rjes su dpags na/ bdag nyid chen po 'di chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i sku'i skye ba bzhes par mngon mod/ de lta na'ang chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam par 'phrul par bshad pa dang 'gal bar dogs pa cung zad kyang med do/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sprul pa dang skye ba du ma bzung nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa chos nyid yin pas so snyam du sems so/ /de nas rim gyis paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid la/ tshe dpag med dze ta ri'i lugs/ grub rgyal mo'i snyan brgyud/ kye'i rdo rje'i rgyu lam/ gzungs gra lnga'i dbang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa/ mgon po'i rjes gnang la sogs pa chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig gsan cing / thugs brtse ba chen pos spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar 'tsho bar mdzad pa zhig yin no/ /zhes thos te/ nyid kyi zhal nas/ mi nyag paṇa chen zhal las byis pa'i dus/ /dbang dang byin rlabs ci rigs nyung zad nyan/ /mang po'i gsung gi bdud rtsi ma thob kyang / /ma nor bka' srol lam du legs bcug cing / /shin tu thugs brtse bka' drin bla na med/ /ces gsungs so/ /de dag gi skabs su bla ma legs pa bzang po ba zhes bya bas yon tan thams cad kyi phyi mo'i 'bri klog 'bul bar brtsams pa na/ rgyal bu don grub yi ge pa bcu bdun gyi bshes gnyen la yi ge slob pa'i tshul ston pa ltar/ 'bri klog gnyis ka brda bstan pa tsam gyis thogs med du mkhyen cing / khyad par sku tshe du ma goms pa lhur mdzad pa'i bag chags sad pas/ rgya dpe dang sngags klog pa nyid gzhan pas chod che zhing / ring thung dang gcod mtshams dod la/

dag gsal snyan pa'i gsung gis gzhan gyi rna ba'i dbang po la sim pa ster bar mdzad pa nyid yin la/ yi ge'i rigs bod kyi yi ge mi the ba'i rgya gar ba'i yig rigs mi 'dra ba drug tsam dang / mkha' 'gro'i yi ge dang / hor yig gsar la sogs pa gzigs pa tsam gyi dgongs shing / 'bri ba dang klog pa'i tshul thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab kyi 'jug pa gzhan las phul du byung bas skye bo thams cad ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gyur pa yin no/ /de nas dgung lo drug tu phebs pa na/ sgo lnga dge sding gi gtsug lag khang nas/ dkyil 'khor pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po spyan drangs nas/ dpal kye rdo rje'i dbang / rdo rje phur pa'i dbang / drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang / tshe dpag med kyi dbang rigs gnyis/ pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi dbang / gur mgon lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang / gdong bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / dkar bdud lcam dral gyi rjes gnang la sogs pa gsan cing thugs su yang chud par mdzad do/ /des na bdag nyid chen po 'di ni/ gzhon nu'i dus nyid nas yon tan gyi chos du ma la mnga' mdzad cing / sngon gyi bag chags sad pas rigs grol smra ba'i spobs pas chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa la brtson la/ tha na sku rtse ba'i gnas skabs na yang / chos 'chad pa dang / sgom mdzad pa dang / dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshul la sogs pa chos dang mthun pa'i rtsed 'jo skye bo mtha' dag gi yid 'dzin pa la mkhas shing / gsung snyan zhing 'jebs la brda 'phrod par gsung ba dang / sku'i skye mched shin tu mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba dang / dbu skra lcang lo'i tshul du mdzad pa/ skye bo gzhan gyis mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog cing / dwang ba khyad par can skyed par mdzad pa'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang ldan pas/ dus mnyam pa'i skye bo sus kyang 'gran par mi nus pa zhig yin no zhes thos so/

/gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po 'di sku na gzhon nu'i dus sku 'khor 'ga' zhig dang bcas te/ steng rtse zhes pa'i gsil khang gi yang thog na sku rtse ba'i slad du bzhugs pa'i dus zhig chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sku'i cha byad shin tu mdzes pa seng ge la chibs pa zhig nam mkha' la bzhugs pa gzigs te/ sku 'khor rnams la 'di lta bu zhig 'dug pa khyed tshos e mthong zhes pa'i bka' lung phebs kyin 'dug ces sku'i gcung rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas gsung ngo zhes kyang gleng ste/ 'di lta bu'i rigs can 'ga' zhig 'byung ba ni sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon par shes pas bdag nyid kyi sku'i skye ba dran pa'i rnam par thar pa yin no snyam du sems mo// //de dag la yang 'di skad ces/ sku ni mdzes shing yid 'ong mthong na dga'/ /gsung ni 'jam zhing snyan la 'phrod par smra/ /thugs ni chos kyi bag chags bzang pos bgos/ /gzhon nur gyur kyang byis pa'i spyod las 'das/ /de tshe nges pa'i don du 'jam dbyangs nyid/ /gdul bya'i snang ngor sa skya paṇa chen zhes/ /snyan grags kun gyi gtsug gi brgyan pa de/ /rang snang ye shes tshul du gsal bar gzigs/ /gnyis pa rab tu byung nas bstan pa'i bya ba ji ltar mdzad pa'i rnam thar la gnyis te/ tshigs snga ma gnyis kyi rten la bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul dang / tshigs phyi ma dge slong gi rten la mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ nges 'byung gi tshul khrims nos pa'i tshul/ rten la bslab sbyangs mdzad pa'i tshul/ mdzad pa'i gtso bo bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtse chen kun dga'i thugs rje ring nas babs/ /bsod nams ye shes rtse mo'i mkhyen pa brnyes/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan mdzad pa'i dpal mnga' ba/ /skye dgu'i 'dren pa bzang po khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes te/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni/ rje btsun gong ma yab sras gsum gyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad la mnga' mdzad cing /

chos rje khu dbon gnyis kyi sku nyams su bstar ba'i rab tu byung ba'i brtul zhugs la'ang gnas par mdzad nas skye dgu mang po'i 'dren pa dam pa mdzad par dgongs te/ de'i tshul ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di dgung lo bcu'i bar du/ pad+ma 'dam na gnas kyang 'dam gyi dri mas ma gos pa ltar/ khyim du bzhugs kyang khyim gyi 'ching bas nam yang gos pa mi mnga' zhing / srid pa'i phun tshogs thams cad rmi lam gyi yul gyi dga' skyid dang 'dra bar snying po med cing / nges par bslu ba'i chos can kho nar gzigs su zin yang / nges par logs pa'i lam don du gnyer ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal thams cad kyi 'byung gnas khyim gyi 'ching ba mtha' dag dug can gyi zas ltar du spang dgos so zhes shes par bya ba dang / bstan pa'i rtsa ba lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che mi nyams shing dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i slad du/ byang grol dad pa'i yon tan gyi thugs legs par drangs pa'i rab tu 'byung bar mdzad par bzhed pa na/ mnga' ris smad gyi yul ljongs nas/ thub pa'i ring lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa gsum na gsal ba de dbus gtsang du phebs nas/ e waṃ dang thub bstan rnam rgyal la sogs par ci rigs par bzhugs te zab rgyas kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po skor ba'i snyan pa'i grags pa gsan pas thugs phrogs par gyur cing / sngar paṇa chen grags pa rdo rje'i bka' lung la/ chos rje glo bo mkhan chen pa de dbus gtsang phyogs su phebs pa shar na/ rang re'i bla ma'i 'os yin no zhes gsung ba zhig yod pa de yang thugs la bzhag ste yab kyis bka' shog mdzad nas mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpon slob rnams spyan 'dren gyi pho nya btang bas/ rje de nyid sngar e waṃ du thugs dam la bzhugs pa'i skabs kyi mnal lam zhig tu/

gdan sa chen po'i dpon po ri yin zer ba'i ri mthon po mnga' ris tshun chod mthong ba zhig gi rtse na/ mgon po'i 'cham sku gcig dang btsun pa zhwa dmar po gyon pa mang po 'dug pa'i btsun pa de rnams kyi rje la phyag 'tshal ba dang / ja 'dren pa la sogs pa'i snang ba byung ba thugs la dran te/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud rin po che la nyams pa yin nges pa'i dad pa dang nges shes khyad par can 'khrungs shing / zhabs tog 'grub pa'i rten 'brel gzigs nas zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas dgung lo bcu gcig bzhes pa shing mo yos bu'i lo/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpon slob rnams dpal rtse gdong gi phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du spyan drangs/ thog mar rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i rjes gnang dang / tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang la sogs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig gsan cing / smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs la bstan pa'i rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa rnam par dag pas thugs brgyud legs par gtams shing / rab tu byung ba'i brtul zhugs la'ang gnas par mdzad do/ /de nas chos kyi rje de nyid las thog mar 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos mdzad pa'i thub pa dgongs gsal zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos chen mo zhang mdo sde dpal gyi sgrung 'grel dang / mkhan chen chos kyi rje de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sa rdar thabs mdo sbyor spyi don sogs kyi stengs nas bshad pa legs par gsan pas/ sngon gyi bag chags bzang po sad pa'i stobs kyis/ dka' tshegs med par tshig dang don du bcas pa thugs su chud nas lo de nyid kyi nang du rnal gzhag mdzad par dgongs te/ sku'i gcung rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas dang sku mched gnyis ka gdan sa chen por phyag phebs pa'i yar lam dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par phebs/ der bzhugs pa'i mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pas bsu ba'i yo byad dang /

ser phreng gi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas bkur bsti dang bcas te spyan drangs shing / bsnyen cing bkur bas mnyes par mdzad/ rgyal gyi zla ba'i yar tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyi ma phyed yol tsam grib tshod rkang pa gnyis kyi dus su lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi 'dren mchog dam pa mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang / dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan zhing sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mnga' brnyes pa'i bdag nyid/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ rdo rje 'chang chen po dkon mchog 'phel ba'i drung du mkhan po zhus shing / chos kyi rje mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas kyis slob dpon mdzad nas/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa nos shing / mtshan yang don dang mthun par 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bar gsol te/ dul ba'i glang po che gser gyi drwa bas brgyan pa ltar cha lugs mdzes shing bag dang ldan la/ bslab par bya ba'i gnas phra zhing phra ba la yang kha na ma tho ba'i dri mas ma dgos pa'i btsun pa'i mchog tu gyur par mdzad nas/ rab tu byung ba'i dga' ston du mkhan slob kyis gtso mdzad/ dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa la bsnyen bkur 'bul nod bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad do/ /de ltar ngur smrig gi bla gos 'dzin pa rnams kyi nang na ches mchog tu gsal zhing mos la/ lha dang mi thams cad kyis mchod pa'i gnas dam par gyur pa'i bdag nyid chen po gzhan la phan par gzhol ba'i brtse ba can 'di ni/ thog ma med pa nas goms pa'i dbang gis byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis kyis thugs brgyud yongs su gang zhing / bdag pas gzhan gces par 'dzin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa brlabs po che dang ldan la/ nges pa'i don du bde ba dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i lam mngon du mdzad zin kyang /

mkhan po chos kyi rje de nyid las so so'i cho ga las thob pa'i sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin nod par bzhed nas/ snga phyir brgyud pa rnam par dag pa las 'ong ba'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa dang / bcom ldan 'das snying po kye rdo rje yab yum gyi dkyil 'khor du mngon par dbang bskur ba la sogs pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i bka' drin mang du mnos nas/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes ltung gi dri ma phra mos kyang ma gos pa'i dge 'dun rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por bzhugs pa yin no zhes thos te/ nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ bdag kyang skye ba snga mar las bzang po'i/ /smon lam mtshams sbyar gtsang ma'i ris skyes nas/ /chung ngu'i dus nas rigs kyi bag chags sad/ /rab tu 'byung 'dod gegs med chos sgor zhugs/ /rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin las/ /'khrul med cho gas dbang dang sems bskyed blangs/ /nyams len med kyang dam tshig ma nyams tsam/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/ mgon khyod srid pa'i 'ching bas ma gos shing / /'khor ba'i phun tshogs snying po med gzigs kyang / /mchog gi spyod pas 'gro rnams rjes bzung phyir/ /khyim gyi 'ching ba dug can zas bzhin spangs/ /slar yang e waṃ chos kyi 'jug ngogs cher/ /blo gsal chu bya mang pos mdun bsus te/ /mkhan slob ngang pa'i ded dpon bka' drin las/ /bslab gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtshor rim gyis zhugs/ /gnyis pa rten de la bslab sbyangs mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ slob dpon mkhas pa'i zhal gyi chu gter las/ /rim par 'phos pa'i legs bshad 'od dkar can/ /khyod kyi rnam dpyod shar ri'i rtser blangs te/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa sel ba'i dpal du mdzad/ /ces te/ de nas gtso bor bstan pa'i bya ba klog pa thos bsam nyid gal che bar dgongs nas/ mkhan chen chos kyi rje de nyid la mnga' ba'i mdo sngags kyi dam pa'i chos phal mo che dang /

khyad par kye rdo rje rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud gsum rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab kyi steng nas bshad pa zhib la mtha' chod pa dang / gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag la sogs pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs mang du gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /mkhan slob 'di gnyis las dam pa'i chos gsan pa'i rnam grangs rnams brjod po ba'i phyir dus phyis gsan pa rnams dang lhan cig 'og tu brjod par bya'o// //gsum pa mdzad pa'i gtso bo bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum ste/ bstan pa la rnam par gzhag pa'i tshul dang / bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba'i tshul/ bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam bsgom gsum mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'jam mgon gnyis pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal du slar byon te/ /ngo mtshar mkhyen brtse'i lang tsho ngom mkhas pa'i/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes te/ dgung lo bcu gnyis la nye ba tsam na/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mkhan chen chos kyi rje dang dpon slob lhan gcig tu de bzhin gshegs pa slob ma'i tshogs kyi bskor ba'i/ zla ba rgyu skar gyi dbus na gsal ba ltar/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sde snod 'dzin pa du ma'i 'khor gyis bskor te/ dpon skya dang drung 'khor dang las sna 'dzin pa'i skye bo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas zhabs 'bring ba byas te/ gdan sa chen po'i phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo sgyur bar mdzad nas rim gyis phebs te/ gdan sa chen po'i bla brang rin chen sgang du bzhugs/ lo gsar gyi dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes la gangs ri'i khrod kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i chos kyi khri ga la ba der zhabs zung 'khor lo'i ri mo rtsan pa'i khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po chen por lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi mnga' gsol te/

mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas thog drangs/ gdan sa chen po'i bla ma slob dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ brgya tsho so so'i dpon la sogs pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu dang / dpon chen la sogs pa'i mi chen po mang po dang bcas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs stong phrag du ma tshogs pa la/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi lam po che thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos chen po yongs su rdzogs par/ sku'i cha byad mdzes shing brjid chags la/ gsung ma stabs shing mtho dman med par de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul ltar/ dpal gyi mgur nas 'phrul gyi ljags brkyangs te/ 'gal dang ma 'brel zlos pa'i skyon las grol zhing / brjod bya'i don 'byed la/ brjod byed kyi ngag tshig sdebs legs pa/ dbang gsal snyan pa'i gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs lta bus nyi ma gsum gyi bar du legs par bshad pas/ skye bo'i tshogs thams cad shin tu ngo mtshar shing / sku na gzhon nu 'di lta bu la sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rmad du byung ba 'di 'dra ba 'byung ba 'di ni nges par chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta nyid gdul bya'i don du slar yang sku skye ba bzhes pa yin yang dag go /zhes mkhas pa'i skye bo thams cad kyis dad pa dang gus pa chen pos mchog tu bsngags pa'i gnas su gyur cing / 'dus pa'i dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa la rnam gzhag gi dga' ston rgya chen po yang bsgrubs te/ mthong thos kyi yul du byas pa'i skye bo thams cad gus pa'i thal mo spyi bor sbyor ba la ngal ba lhur byed do zhes thos so/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/ 'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku/ /rim par byon pa'i dpal ldan sa skya zhes/ /grags pa'i rnga chen srid na gsal ba der/ /bcu gnyis bzhes tshe bshad pa'i dga' ston bsgrubs/ /sku ni 'khor tshogs dbus na zla ltar brjid/ /gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar dal dod snyoms/

/thugs ni shes bya'i gnas la gsal bar 'jug /yon tan skye bo kun gyi kha na rgyu// //gnyis pa bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba'i tshul ni/ 'jam gling sa la dbang sgyur 'phags pa yi/ /zhabs stegs nor bu'i khri la rtag 'khod nas/ /theg gsum chos kyi rgyal srid skyong mkhas pa'i/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i rgyal tshab khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes te/ dus de nyid nas brtsams te bdag nyin chen po 'di'i snyan pa'i grags pa lha'i rnga bo che lta bus rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas pa'i sa chen po 'di mngon par khyab par gyur pas blo gsal zhing gzu bor gnas pa'i skyes bu thams cad bdag nyid chen po'i yon tan 'ba' zhig sgrog pas brel zhing / dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chos dang srid kyi bka' 'bangs su gtogs pa thams cad char 'dod kyi byi'us dbyar skyes kyi sgra thos pa ltar dga' zhing mgu la gus pa'i rnam 'gyur tsam yang 'dzin par byed la/ khyad par lugs gnyis la mkhyen pa gsal ba'i seng ge rtse'i sa skyong chen mo bkra shis rgyal mos mthil bzhugs mdzad de/ gdan sa chen po'i bka' bgros pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab nas bzhi thog gzim khang du spyan drangs te/ 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gdan seng ge'i khri ga la ba der zhabs zung rnam par bkod nas bstan pa'i bdag po chen por mnga' gsol te/ 'dzam gling byang phyogs kyi rgyud na gnas pa'i skye dgu thams cad mgon dang bcas par mdzad cing / sa chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'di yang snul zhing mdzes la mchog tu 'od chags pa'i dpal dang ldan par mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas brtsams te gdan sa chen po'i dbyar chos dang dgun chos la sogs pa la khor mar phebs shing chos dang srid kyi mdzad pa thams cad gong 'phel du gyur pa yin no/ /zhes thos so/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/ mkhyen brtse'i yon tan gting mtha' mi dpogs pa/ /'di ni 'jam dbyangs mi yi gzugs can zhes/

/sa gsum skye bo kun gyi khar rgyu zhing / /snyan grags rnga chen srid pa'i rtse mor brdungs/ /de tshe sa skyong dbang mo'i dad gus dang / /rang srid 'byor ba'i dpal 'bras kyis mchod nas/ /srid gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren par mnga' phul te/ /'dzin ma'i 'khyon 'di rdzogs ldan ji bzhin bskyangs// //gsum pa bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam bsgom gsum mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ thog med dus nas shes bya kun mkhyen yang / /'jig rten drangs phyir yongs 'dzin mkhas rnams las/ /rigs gnas chu gter rnam dpyod hub gcig gis/ /skad cig nyid la 'dren mkhas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes te/ de nas yang rgyal ba'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams la mkhyen pa'i spyan rab tu gsal ba'i dbang po rwa dbon yon tan 'byung gnas zhes grags pa rtse gdong du spyan drangs nas/ lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa mtha' dag gi mdzod du gyur pa 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba dang / 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po bsdus pa lta bu 'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa/ rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel/ sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos tshad ma rig pa'i gter/ sdom pa gsum gyis rab tu dbye ba la sogs pa gtso bor gyur pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig lung rig gi mtha' spyod dang bcas te legs par gsan cing dka' ba'i gnas rnams 'bel gtam dang rig lung gi sgo nas kyang gtan la phab pas/ mkhyen pa'i spyan zur lhung ba tsam gyis shes par bya ba'i gnas de dang de dag gi dpyis phyin par rgyu mtshan dang bcas par legs par dgongs shing thugs su chud la/ khyad par du tshad ma rig pa'i gter gyi 'grel pa 'grel bshad dang bcas pa du ma'i tshig don thams cad me long dwangs pa la gzugs brnyan rnam par bkra ba ltar/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i thugs la gsal bar smin te/ brgal zhing brtags pa'i tshul gyis rigs pa dang mi rigs pa dang mi rigs pa rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas pa'i spobs pas pha rol gyi zil gyis gnon par mi nus pa'i smra ba'i khyu mchog chen por gyur pas dus mnyam pa'i skye bo kun/

shes rab mtshungs med de lta bu 'jam dbyangs ma gtogs gzhan la mi yong zhes zer/ de dus snga dro gsol ja sbyor re tsam gyi bar la mda' tshad shog bu bdun re tsam zin pa yang byas zhes gsungs zhing / ji snyed mkhyen cing thugs su chud pa thams cad kyang 'bad rtsol chen pos nan tan mi dgos par lo brgyar sbyangs pa ltar bsnyel ba med pa'i dran pa dang / gtugs pa med pa'i spobs pa btags thogs pa med par rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba ni bdag nyid chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan du snang ngo / /nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / gsang ston slob dpon yon tan 'byung gnas la/ /'dul ba mdo rtsa kā ri kā la sogs/ /tshad ma rnam 'grel rig gter sdom gsum dang / /pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs 'ga' zhig mnos/ /sngags kyi sdeb sbyor lag len phran tshegs bslabs/ /de ltar thos pa'i gzhung lugs thams cad la/ /bsal bas sgro 'dogs chod cing bsgom na yang / /the tshom mi za yid ches cung zad yod/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas bar skabs zhig tu dpal sa skya'i rin chen sgang du/ chos kyi rgyal po rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan sku mched kyi nang rten rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gser sku gdan sa chen po'i chu byang na sku tshad che bar grags pa bzhengs/ e waṃ nas 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po dpon slob rnams spyan drangs nas rab gnas kyi cho ga rgyas pa dang / bkra shis dang dga' ston rgya chen po mdzad cing dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig kyang gsan nas so sor chags phebs/ slar yang yab kyi dgongs rdzogs dang sgo bstun nas rtse gdong du spyan drangs te zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos mang du gsan no/ /lug lo'i dbyar 'dren mchog chos kyi rje'i bkas gdan sa'i dbyar chos la phebs mi dgos na/ gnas skabs su bar chad zhi zhing mthar thug yi dam lhas rjes su 'dzin la/ rang gzhan gyi don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur bas/

thugs dam bsnyen pa mdzad na shin tu legs pa'i bka' lung dang / nyam len mdzad tshul gyi bslab bya dang / chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu sogs byin rlabs kyi rten dang bcas pa gnang ba la brten/ rtse gdong bla brang gi gzims khang rtser dpon slob nyung shas kyis sku mtshams mdzad nas stan thog gcig tu mi tshig gi bar ma chod pa'i dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi bsnyen pa dang / bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen pa/ rdo rje nag po chen po'i bsnyen pa rnams mthar phyin par mdzad pas mtshan ma khyad par can du ma brnyes par gyur to/ /de nas brtsams te gnas skabs thams cad du rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin zab mo la thugs nam yang g.yel ba mi mnga' zhing / mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa rnams kyang dus las yol ba mi srid la/ 'chad nyan dang gzigs rtog la sogs pa thams cad kyang snang steng sgyu ma lta bur mkhyen pa'i chos can 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi nyams len gyi gnad zab mo dang ma bral bar mdzad pas thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor tshun chad kyang rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i nyams len kho na sku nyams su bstar bar mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes khums so/ /de nas yang shing pho byi ba'i lo'i dbyar/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rje rtse gdong gi srid gsum rnam rgyal gyi chos sder spyan drangs te gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag dang / sa skya pa'i lcags ri'i khongs mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhi la sogs pa gdams ngag de'i cha lag zab mo thams cad nyams 'khrid kyi tshul du legs par gsan cing / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i dbang dang byin rlabs dang / rlung dang 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa'i phyag len phra zhing phra ba tshun chod kyang legs par sbyangs shing thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed dang / de dag gi bslab bya dang /

dam tshig gi bshad pa dang / bskyed rim gyi bshad pa dang / zur bka' kha yar dang / rjes gnang dang lung gi tshogs rab tu mang po dang bcas pa gsan cing / gsan pa de dag kyang ming tsam ma yin par dpyis phyin par mdzad pas/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rje yang thugs shin tu rangs par gyur te/ chos bdag po la 'phrod pas/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad dgos so zhes gsung zhing dges spro shin tu che bar mdzad/ bdag nyid chen po dpon g.yog rnams kyis kyang bsnyen bkur 'bul nod bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad do/ /dus de nyid kyi tshe rje btsun dam pa mus pa chen po 'dren mchog chos kyi rje mjal ba la rtse gdong du phebs te/ phyogs las rnam rgyal du zhag grangs kha yar ba cig bzhugs/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rje'i bkas gnang nas/ bdag nyid chen po sku mched rnams kyi phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa dang / bde mchog lo dril la sogs pa zab rgyas kyi dam pa'i chos mang du gsan no/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/ dpal ldan rdzogs pa'i byang chub che brnyes pa'i/ /gsung gi dbang phyug rgyal sras gzhon nu yang / /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal snga las/ /mi mnyam chos kyi bdud rtsi'i ro mchog myangs/ /'di na gzhan gyi yun du ma thob pa'i/ /mkhas pas bskyed pa'i legs bshad lang tsho la/ /khyod kyis mkhyen pa'i spyan zur mthong tsam gyis/ /tshig don thugs la gcags pa'i rtse dga' thob// //gnyis pa tshigs phyi ma dge slong gi rten la bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ sdom pa ji ltar nod pa'i tshul dang / nyan bshad ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ khyod kyis thar pa'i skas la bde blag tu/ /bgrod pa mtshon phyir legs gsung 'dul ba nas/ /ji skad bshad pa'i bslab pa kun rdzogs te/ /skyon bral tshangs par spyod pa'i rtse mor 'dzegs/ /zhes te/ de nas yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la zhugs la yongs su rdzogs pa ni dge slong nyid yin par dgongs nas/

dgongs lo nyi shur phebs pa mig dmar zhes pa rgya nag rtsis pa'i shing pho byi ba'i lo/ nyi ma seng ge'i khyim du zhugs pa/ khrums kyi zla ba'i mar ngo'i gral tshes snga dro'i grib tshod rkang pa gnyis dang / skyes bu gcig gi dus su/ mkhan po sngar gyi de nyid dang / las kyi slob dpon rgyal ba'i bka' tshul rab 'byams la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen pa'i spyan ras rab tu gsal zhing / dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen pos skal bar mtshams pa'i gdul bya rnams la mchog tu brtse ba'i bdag nyid/ sa gsum gyi 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rje sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po dang / gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab can yon tan 'byung gnas pas mdzad de/ dge 'dun bcu phrag phyed kyi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa thob par mdzad de/ tshul khrims kyi phung po mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces par gzung nas/ dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyis bslab par bya ba'i cha phra zhing phra ba rnams kyang / gzhan gyis tshegs chen pos bsgrub pa la mi ltos par/ sku gsung thugs kyi dbang po dul zhing zhi la spyod lam bag dang ldan pa'i kun spyod dri ma med pa/ 'phags pa rta thul grong khyer du bsod snyoms la rgyu ba'i rnam par thar pa ltar/ tshul khrims kyi dri bsung rgya mtsho'i gos can gyi mtha' klas par bzhugs te/ 'dod pa bsod nyams kyi mtha' dang / ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i dbu ma'i lam mig 'byed pa/ ye shes 'byed pa nye bar zhi bar gyur pa la brten par mdzad do/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/ zhi dang nyer zhi'i myos bul mtho ldan zhing / /kun nas dul ba'i gser gyi drwa ba can/ /thub bstan skyed tshal mdzes pa'i gnyis 'thung khyod/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i khur chen 'degs par bzod/ /spyod lam kun nas dul ba rta thul te/

/bslab byar gus pa ka ta ya na'i bu/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan ldan pa 'od bsrungs bzhin/ /dri zhim blta na sdug la 'od chags 'bar// //gnyis pa nyan bshad ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ gsan pa gtso bor mdzad pa'i tshul dang / 'chad nyan bsgom gsum spel mar mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ khyod ni mkhyen pa'i lang tsho cher rgyas kyang / /blo gsal yongs kyi dpyad bya 'di yin zhes/ /mang du gsan pa'i snyim pa rab brkyangs te/ /mkhas mang zhal gyi bdud rtsi dges par gsol/ /zhes te/ de ltar nges par legs pa'i lam la gcig tu gzhol zhing lhag pa'i tshul khrims ngur smrig gi gos kyi rab tu mdzes par mdzad nas/ slar yang rang gzhan rnam par grol ba'i bdud rtsi thob par byas pas thabs kyi gtso bo ni/ dam pa'i chos thos nas nyams su len pa dang / gzhan la phan pa gtso bor byed pa nyid yin no snyam du dgongs shing / de yang rtsa ba dri ma med pa'i gsung rab rnams la thos pa bya ba nyid so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi 'jug ngogs yin par mkhyen nas/ bdag cag gi bla ma 'dis yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las ji ltar thos pa mdzad pa'i tshul mdo tsam brjod na/ lha bcas 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te chos kyi rje rdo rje 'chang chen po dkon mchog 'phel ba'i drung du/ snga phyir dam pa'i chos gsan pa'i rnam grangs la/ theg pa chen po dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed/ de gnyis kyi yig cha rje btsun khu dbon gyi mdzad pa'i lung / bcom ldan 'das snying po kye rdo rje'i dbang / bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dbang / gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dbang / 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dbang / mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dbang / tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang / gsung ngag rin po che'i 'khrid/ lam dus kyi dbang / rdo rje bdag med ma'i byin rlabs/

lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi byin rlabs gnyis/ yig brgya dang aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung / rnam 'dzoms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs/ tshar gsum khug pa/ brda don gsal ba sogs lam 'bras dang 'brel ba'i byin rlabs mtha' dag dang lam sbas bshad kyi 'khrid rnams gsan/ de dag dang rjes su 'brel ba'i yig cha la glegs bam du cis kyang bzhugs pa'i yig sna bzhi bcu zhe dgu rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang bcas pa/ las dang po pa dang thun mong du dgos pa'i chos bdun gyi bshad pa dang / lag len/ man ngag phra mo'i rkang grangs du grags pa dkar chag nang bzhin gsan/ gzhan yang bla ma lnga bcu pa/ de'i ṭīk+ka rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ tshogs 'khor tshim pa drug pa/ yab yum gyi bstod pa gnyis/ kye rdo rje'i bkra shis rnams gsan/ rje 'brog mi'i zab chos la/ ḍā+om+bi ba'i lhan cig skyes grub/ mtsho skyes kyi bskyed rim zab pa'i tshul dgu dang / rdzogs rim mar me'i rtse mo lta bu/ ngag dbang grags pa'i phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ tog rtse pa'i bsam mi khyab byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi mchod rten drung thob/ nag po spyod pa ba'i gtum mo lam rdzogs/ nag po u tsi tra 'chi ba med pa'i yon po bsrang ba dang / rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū ti'i phyag rgyas lam rdzogs pa ste/ lam skor phyi ma brgyad du grags pa/ shān+ti pa'i mdo rgyud bsre ba/ dz+nya na shrī dang shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa dang rin chen rdo rje gsum gyi bar chad gsum sel/ ngag dbang grags pa'i gnyug ma dran gsal/ nā ro pa'i sdug bsngal gsum sel te sgo drug chos 'brel du grags pa rnams gsan/ yang gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar thor bu bar grags pa rnams dang / gzhung bshad sras don ma/ 'khrid yig zhang bya ru bas mdzad pa/ klan dkar ba seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/

nyan chen pas mdzad pa gnyags snying po rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa rnams gsan te/ mdor na lam 'bras lam skor zhar byung gi man ngag de dag dang rjes su 'brel ba'i yig cha phran tshegs dang bcas pa/ lam bsdus te sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa'i bar lan gnyis kyi bar du gsan no/ /gzhan yang dril bu rim lnga'i khrid/ byin rlabs yig cha'i lung dang bcas pa/ nag po rim bzhi'i khrid/ rim bzhi lam slong dang / khrid yig gsung bgros ma'i lung dang / bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs khrid dang bcas pa/ byin rlabs kyi yi ge khrid yig che chung gsum/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs dang / de la brten pa'i 'da' kha ma'i man ngag zab mo/ shin tu spros med kyi khrid byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ bir+wa pas mdzad pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung rnams dang / spros med mdzes brgyan/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs rnams gsan/ gzhan yang ku ru kul+le/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ tshogs kyi bdag po rnams kyi rjes gnang gsan nas/ ku ru kul+le'i rjes gnang lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ sgrub thabs lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje gdan pa'i man ngag che chung gsum/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ 'dod rgyal gyi skor la/ sngags kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ dbang gi zhal gdams/ sku gsung thugs kyi rab gnas/ bzlas lung gi man ngag gtor ma'i zhal gdams/ drag po'i las sbyor/ 'khor lo'i man ngag las bzhi'i zin bris/ gsang sgrub/ rin chen sgrub pa'i man ngag zhi rgyas drag rnams la kha sgyur/ sbyin sreg bstod pa/ mchod 'bul/ rtags yig rten 'brel gyi cho ga brgyud pa'i lo rgyus sgrub thabs chos rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ tshogs bdag gi lo rgyus/ sgrub thabs di paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum/ bstod pa 'phags pas mdzad pa/

rjes gnang gi yi ge dbang rgyas gnyis kyi sbyin sreg tshogs bdag gi gzungs rnams gsan/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa ba ri bas bsgyur ba dang / sgrub thabs brgya mtsho spyal lung lo tsā bas bsgyur ba gnyis kyi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa/ thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs kyis rigs gtad/ sgrub thabs mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ rig gtad kyi cho ga skyer sgang pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa/ rnam rgyal lha dgu'i rjes gnang / rnam 'joms ba ri ba'i lugs kyi rjes gnang / gur mgon lcam dral dang lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang dang / las mgon pu tra ming sring gi rjes gnang rnams gsan/ gzhan yang bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u lnga bcu nga gcig pa/ gong ma'i sa bcad/ bka' 'grel mu tig phreng ba/ bshad rgyud rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ rje btsun chen po'i 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i steng nas bshad pa gsan/ gzhan yang kye rdor 'grel pa lugs kyi chos skor la/ sgrub thabs bdud rtsi 'od/ lhan cig skyes grub/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ 'du ba bsgrags pa/ de nyid bcu pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ lha dgu'i sgrub thabs/ phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ dran pa gcig pa gar+bha ba ri pas mdzad pa/ bdag med ma dpa' bo gcig pa bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa/ gur gyi sgrub thabs/ bzang po yongs gzung / yan lag drug pa/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs/ ku mu ti rnams mi thub zla bas mdzad pa/ rin chen 'bar ba/ mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog nas gling ma/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes/ tshogs 'khor dam tshig lnga pa/ bstod pa nyi shu pa/ 'grel pa pad+ma can/ skabs kyi 'grel chung brgyad/ slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gzhung 'grel/ sgrub thabs de nyid gsal ba/ phyag bcu drug pa dpa' gcig bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs che chung gnyis/ rab gnas tshul zab mo/ sbyin sreg ro sreg tshogs 'khor/ gshin gyi cho ga mchod rten gyi cho ga

rdzogs rim gyi gzhung / dgra las rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i phyag rgya bzhi pa rnams gsan/ bde mchog gi skor la/ sdom 'byung gi 'grel pa rat+na rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa/ dpal mngon par rtogs pa/ de'i 'grel pa/ phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga lag mchod/ gtor ma'i cho ga ste lo yī pa'i smad lngar grags pa rnams gsan/ yang nag po pas mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog sbyin sreg ste bskyed rim bskor gsum/ dpyid kyi thig le/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal ba/ o la pa ti ste rdzogs rim skor gsum/ bde mchog lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog rim lnga'i gzhung rnams dril bu pas mdzad pa gsan/ yang gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor la/ sgrub thabs mdor byas/ mdo bsre/ rnam gzhag rim pa/ dkyil chog nyi shu pa/ dkyil chog zung 'jug gsal ba/ dkyil chog dang rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog nag po pas mdzad pa/ rdor sems sgrub thabs zla grags kyis mdzad pa/ byang chub sems 'grel/ ya ra la wa sogs tshul bzhir bshad pa/ rim lnga'i gzhung / don 'grel bsdus don sgron ma/ bdag byin rlabs/ rim pa khong bsdu/ 'gos kyi stong thun chen mo rnams gsan/ ye shes zhabs kyi skor la/ sgrub thabs kun bzang / 'jam dpal zhal lung / grol ba'i thig le/ bdag sgrub pa rnams ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/ zhal lung dang grol thig gi 'grel pa sman pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ gzhan yang rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum/ chos kyi rje rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' 'bum pod bzhi ma/ rje sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi bka' 'bum/ lce btsun bsod nams seng ge'i sngags 'bum sdom gsum gyi skor dang bcas pa rnams gsan/ gzhan yang lam dus kyi dbang bskur tshul/

yig brgya dang aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung gi man ngag rgyu dus kyi ye shes dbab pa'i cho ga bde mchog lo nag gi mchod phreng rig byed ma'i mngon rtogs/ thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ba nyams su len tshul rnams gsan/ gzhan yang bde ba can gyi zhing bkod kyi mdo/ sman bla'i mdo/ de'i cho ga zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa/ lung sil bur grags pa'i mdo sna bcu bdun gyi lung / de rnams kyi sa bcad mchims kyis mdzad pa rnams gsan/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa sdom pa nyi shu pa rje btsun sku mched kyi 'grel pa'i stengs nas bshad pa/ bslab pa kun las btus pa'i lung / jo bo rje'i thugs dam chos chung brgya rtsar grags pa rnams legs par gsan no/ /de ltar yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di nyid la dam pa'i chos kyi bka' lung du ma dang / khyad par brgyud pa dri ma med pa las 'ongs pa'i sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin legs par mnos pas/ dad pa dang gus pa'i dbang po rnam par rgyas pa'i sgo nas rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog tu 'dzin par mdzad pa yin te/ nyid kyi zhal snga nas khyad par rdo rje 'chang chen rat+na'i mtshan/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog dam pa las/ /sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin nyer mnos pas/ /bka' drin che zhing bla ma'i mchog tu bzung / /zhes dang / mgon khyod rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar bzhugs nas/ /mtha' yas skye dgu'i don phyir 'jig rten du/ /rnam par 'phrul pa ji ltar ston mdzad kyang / /lhag par thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/ /zhes gsungs shing / dus mtshams phal che bar 'dren pa dam pa de nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad spyod rnam par dag pa'i bka' mchid kho na gsung / bka' bsgo sogs kyi dus su/ mtshan nas brjod pa'i tshe drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po dkon mchog 'phel zhes spyan tshum pa dang bcas te gsungs pa na/

gzhan pas zil che zhing spu zing zhes byed la/ bcos ma ma yin pa'i mos gus dang / byin rlabs kyi 'khul ches che ba zhig yong bar bdag nyid kyi myong bas grub bo/ /de nas rtse gdong du yab kyi nang rten du thub pa'i gser sku chen mo bzhengs pa dang sgo bstun nas/ glo bo mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa gdan 'dren pa btang / me stag gi lo dbus gtsang du phebs/ thog mar gdan sa chen por rten mjal sogs la rgyun mi ring tsam dang / e waṃ du 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po mjal ba dang / dbang byin rlabs 'ga' zhig gsan pa la phebs/ zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs nas rtse gdong du phebs/ rab byung zhes pa rgya gar ba'i lo mgo me mo yos bu'i lo zla ba dang po la rten gyi rab gnas mdzad/ 'brug lo tshang ma dang sbrul lo'i zla ba gsum pa yan rtse gdong phyogs kho nar bzhugs te/ sku mched rnams kyi gtso mdzad skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la dam pa'i chos kyi char chen po 'bebs par mdzad de/ de ltar mkhan chen chos kyi rje de las snga phyir dbang bskur gsan pa'i rnam grangs la/ thog mar bya ba spyi'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i rigs gsum spyi dbang / rnam 'joms ma ṇi badz+ra gyi lugs/ gzungs grwa lnga/ gdugs dkar can/ 'od zer can lha lnga/ tshe dpag med lha dgu/ gza' yum gyi byabs srung / bcu gcig zhal lha mang / dpa' bo gcig grub nas gsungs pa'i a ra pa tsa na lha lnga/ phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa/ gshed dmar/ lha bcu gsum ma rwa lugs kyi rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor dang bcu gsum ma/ skyer lugs bcu bdun ma/ zhe dgu ma/ gdong drug rwa lugs/ dgra nag zhang lugs/ 'khor lo chen mo/ bde mchog lo nag dril gsum/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ dril bu lha lnga/ bong zhal can so bdun/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gsum/ ma hā ma ya lha lnga/ sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga/ ku ru kul+le lha lnga/

dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i 'khor lo sdom chen/ rdo rje phur pa sa lugs kyi dbang / drag po'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ kye rdo rje bka' babs bzhir grags pa dang / bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dbang / rta mgrin yang gsang lha dgu'i dbang / gu ru bka' brgyad kyi dbang ste/ mdor na dbang bka' 'di rnams dang rjes su 'brel ba'i sgrub dkyil gzhung phran sogs yig cha du ma'i lung dang bcas pa gsan no/ /gzhan yang rdo rje bdag med ma'i byin rlabs/ sa lugs kyi dmar mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs yig lung dang bcas pa/ dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs/ phag mo gzhung drug gi lung / bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs/ bde mchog skor gyi man ngag phra mo du ma'i lung dang bcas pa gsan/ rjes gnang gi skor la/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ don zhags lha lnga/ sgrol ma dkar mo 'chi bslu'i man ngag dang bcas pa/ gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa/ mtshan brgya'i lung dang bcas pa/ mi g.yo mgon po'i rjes gnang chu bsrung dang bcas pa/ ri khrod lo ma can/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na/ smra seng / dpa' bo grub pa/ 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang / 'jam dbyangs ye shes yon tan bzang po'i rigs gtad/ 'jam dbyangs nag po'i man ngag mi g.yo ba dkar po/ rnam rgyal 'joms/ seng ge sgra/ bcu gcig zhal/ rta mgrin jo lugs/ zla rgyal lugs/ phyag na rdo rje dbu tsar+ya'i rjes gnang / gos sngon can gyi rig gtad rnams yig lung dang bcas pa/ don zhags dpa' bo gcig gi rig gtad/ dmar po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang / man ngag rnams kyi lung dang bcas pa/ gur gyi mgon po lcam dral dang lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang / de'i man ngag gser pod du grags pa dang / sgrub yig rnying pa dkar chag nang bzhin dang / gdong bzhi pa'i man ngag dkar chag nang bzhin gsan no/ /gzhan yang ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / phyag rdor 'gro bzang dang /

rnam sras kyi rjes gnang rnams yig lung dang bcas pa/ seng ge gdong can gyi bsgom lung / khyung khra'i sgrub thabs/ sme rtsegs dang klu dbang gi rgyal po'i bsgom lung rnams gsan no/ /bshad pa dang lung gi skor la/ kye rdo rje rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud gsum/ sa skya pa gong ma'i yig cha rnams kyi steng nas tshul bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i bshad pa rgyas pa/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ ma hā mā ya'i rgyud/ 'jigs byed rtog bdun sa lugs/ rwa lugs/ 'jigs byed rtog gsum/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ rab gnas kyi rgyud/ dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud/ rnam rgyal gyi rtog pa/ gdugs dkar can gyi rtog pa/ tshe dpag med kyi mdo/ dpal mngon par rtogs pa'i bshad pa/ pu hrangs lo chung nas brgyud pa'i nag 'bum du grags pa'i lung rnams kyang gsan no/ /khrid kyi skor la/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag de dang 'brel ba'i dbang byin rlabs du ma/ dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed dang bcas pa/ glegs bam du bzhugs pa'i yig sna zhe dgu sogs yig cha'i lung du ma dang / gzhung bshad dmar ma/ de'i zin bris bar ston gyis mdzad pa rnams kyi lung / nag po rim bzhi dang dpyid kyi thig le'i khrid/ nag 'bum gyi lung / yum la brten pa'i rtsa dbu ma/ 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim rwa rtse sems 'dzin/ ḍom+bi he ru ka'i byin rlabs/ rten 'brel gyi srung ba rnams kyi lung dang bcas pa/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i ri chos skor gsum gyi lung / sa paṇa gyi bka' 'bum thor bu ba kha yar dang / thub pa'i skyes rabs/ dbu ma shes spring / chos dbyings bstod pa sogs bstod tshogs du ma/ zab mo mdo lnga/ mdo sde 'dzangs blun/ sgrol ma'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig sogs kyi lung / chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bka' 'bum gyi lung la sogs pa mchog tu zab pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin mang du gsan pa yin te/

nyid kyi zhal nas/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs las ches zab pa'i/ /kye rdor rgyud gsum gsang mtha' gur mgon sogs/ /thun mong ma yin yid ches gnad rnams zhus/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/ gzhan gyi ma pham mkhas pa'i thugs mtsho las/ /dal gyis 'bab pa'i snyan rgyud chu chen bzhi/ /mkhyen brtse'i gting mtha' gzhan gyis ma rtogs pa'i/ /blo bzang khyod kyi thugs kyi rgya mtshor bskyil/ /'di ni ting 'dzin nor bu'i ma ma ste/ /'di ni mkhas grub klu dbang bsti gnas che/ /'di ni blo gsal chu bya'i nyer mtsho'i gzhi/ /'di ni dbyangs can zhal gyi chu gter ro// //gnyis pa 'chad nyan bsgom gsum spel mar mdzad pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa spyir bstan pa dang / bstan pa'i bgyi ba rlabs po che mdzad tshul bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thos pa'i cha shas gong nas gong 'phel zhing / /bsam pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom byung ri mos bkra/ /smra mkhas bdud rtsi'i 'od kyi drwa ba can/ /blo gsal bde 'byung gtsug na rtag par mdzes/ /zhes te/ sbrul lo zla ba bzhi pa la yab sras gnyis phyags bteg ste/ mkhan chen chos kyi rje yar lam e waṃ du phebs nas/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po las/ zhing skyong chen po tsa tur mu kha'i rjes gnang la sogs pa'i zab chos 'ga' zhig gsan/ bka' bsgo dang byin rlabs zhus nas yar phyogs la phebs/ gdan sa chen por zla ba lnga pa la yab sras mjal/ mchod khang dang mgon khang rnams su dkar me dang mchod gtor rgya chen po mdzad de/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa stod phyogs kyi gdul bya rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos mnga' ris phyogs la phebs te/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don yun ring du mdzad/ bdag nyid chen pos dbyar chos ma grub kyi bar du gdan sa chen por bzhugs nas shin tu zab pa'i dbang lung rjes gnang 'ga' zhig gis 'os su gyur pa'i gdul bya du ma smin grol la bkod/

dbyar smad e waṃ du phebs nas zab rgyas kyi chos 'ga' zhig gsan cing / mang ja 'bul 'gyed la sogs pa mdzad/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal pos bka' gnang nas/ chos dung bus te/ rtsod dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po'i chos kyi khrir zhabs pad mngon par bkod nas/ dge 'dun tshogs pa thams cad la 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes su gnang ba/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i lung dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang 'jam dbyangs kyi rigs kyi rjes gnang mi 'dra ba kha yar gnang ste/ gdul bya rnams kyi dad pa dang blo gros kyi dbang po yongs su rgyas par mdzad do/ /stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rim par byon pa'i pho brang chen po gzhis kha rin chen spungs pa'i bya 'dabs/ ra lnga zhes pa'i khang bzang na/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mang du thos pa'i nags kyi sman ljongs ches cher yangs pa'i gnas su rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i dmar ser ral pa'i khur gyis rnam par brjid la/ nges don zab mo'i de nyid gsal bar gzigs pa'i spyan mig rab tu bgrad pas log par lta ba'i ri dwags phra mo thal bar mdzad pa'i gdong lnga'i dbang po chag lo tsā ba rin chen chos kyi rgyal po bzhugs pa'i drung du phebs te/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang / lus dkyil lha nyer lnga ma'i dbang / mgon po lha bcu gnyis ma dang brgyad ma'i dbang la sogs pa zab cing dkon pa'i chos mang du gsan/ de rjes yangs pa'i rgyal khams chen po la dbang mdzad pa'i mi'i dbang po chen po don yod rdo rjes zhabs tog nar mar phul nas/ rim gyis chos 'khor lha sa'i gtsug lag khang chen por phebs/ shākya'i rgyal pos gtso bo mdzad rten gsum khyad par can rnams la zhal gser/ snyan dar mthong ras/ mar me/ zhal zas rnams kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu bkod de/ dad gus kyi shugs drag pos shing sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa lta bu'i phyag bgrang ba las 'das pa mdzad cing /

nyi ma bdun gyi bar du theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed dang / bstan pa rin po che dar shing rgyas pa dang / sems can rnams bde zhing skyid pa'i smon lam rgya chen po mdzad/ yar lam 'u ljangs rdo'i lha khang du phebs te smon lam mdzad/ yar 'brog dpal de/ sna dkar rtse/ stag lung rnams su spyan drangs/ dbang lung man ngag du ma gnang ste/ chos kyi bdud rtsis skye bo dad pa can rnams tshim par mdzad/ ston e waṃ du 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po mjal ba dang bka' lung 'ga' zhig gsan pa la phebs/ bdag nyid chen pos kyang sgrol ma bla med kyis phyi dkyil/ nang dkyil lha nyer lnga ma/ rdo rje phur pa la sogs pa'i dbang bka' 'ga' zhig gnang / de dus rje btsun dam pa mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po e waṃ du phebs pa dang gdan 'dzoms nas/ rdo rje gur dang / saṃ bu ṭa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang la sogs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig gsan/ de nas gdan sa chen por phebs te/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam+bha wa'i slob ma sad mi bdun gyi nang nas mkhyen rab mchog tu yangs pa 'khon klu'i dbang po srung ba dang / rigs sngags kyi nus mthu mthar phyin pa rdo rje rin chen nas brtsams te 'khon gyi gdung rgyud rim par byon pa rnams rdo rje phur pa la sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas lha'i gnang ba thob pa dang / byin rlabs kyi nus mthu mthar phyin pa kho na byung zhing / de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po nas gong ma rim par byon pa rnams gsang sngags phyi 'gyur la thugs dad par gyur kyang / rdo rje phur pa la yi dam gyi lhar mdzad pa sha stag byung ba dang / khyad par snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i mgon skyabs dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang / shar phyogs nor 'dzin skyong ba'i rgyal po ta'i yun los gtso mdzad skye dgu mang po dang /

'dren pa dam pa theg chen chos kyi rgyal po dang / chos kyi rgyal po rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams kyis rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod rgyas par gnang ba'i phyag len gyi rgyun mi nyams shing rgyas par bya ba'i slad du skyes bdag gi lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes bzhi nas dpal rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod rgyas pa/ sa chog gi 'cham la sogs cha lag dang bcas pa zhag grangs du ma mdzad/ gdan sa chen po'i 'byor ldan dad pa can rnams kyis kyang bsnyen bkur zhabs tog rgya chen po phul/ de nas brtsams te phyogs der char chu dus su 'bab pa dang / lo legs pa dang / skye 'gro nye ba la sogs pa'i bkra shis dang dge mtshan du ma byung ngo zhes skye bo thams cad sgrog par byed do/ /dbyar smad e waṃ du phebs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa la sogs pa'i zab rgyas kyi chos mang du gsan cing / bdag nyid chen pos kyang rdo rje phur pa dang / bde mchog dril bu lha lnga dang / ku ru kul+le lha lnga la sogs pa'i dbang bskur re re nas kyang cha du ma dang / phur pod kyi lung dang rjes gnang du ma gnang / de nas rtse gdong gi sgos gzhis mdo chos gzim khang du phebs te sku mtshams mdzad nas thugs dam zab mo la rtse gcig tu bzhugs/ bar skabs zhig tu lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bla ma brgyud pa yongs su rdzogs pa bdag nyid chen po'i rtsa ba'i bla ma kha yar dang bcas pa'i lam gser gyi sku nyi shu rtsa bgrangs tsam gcig mnga' ris pa'i lha bzo ba kun bzang zhes pas bzhengs nas gzungs bzhugs dang rab gnas la sogs pa thams cad rdzogs par mdzad de mdo chos gzim khang na bzhugs pa dus phyis dpal sa skyar spyan drangs nas rin chen sgang na bzhugs so/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams dang / de dag gi bzhugs gnas pho brang chen po rnams kyi cha tshad kyi rjes su 'gro zhing /

snang zhing srid pa'i bkod pa du ma bde dang gyog du mig gi bdud rtsir bgyi ba'i sprul pa'i lha bzo ba sman kang pa sku mched kyis bris pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i dris sku rnams dang / dus phyis 'khor lo bde mchog gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang / gsung ngag rin po che'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams la bla ma yi dam 'dod lha chos skyong rnams kyis bskor ba'i bris sku che zhing bkod pa mdzes pa mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog cing dwang ba khyad par can bskyed par byed pa'i tshogs bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig kyang 'jig rten gyi yon gnas mchog tu sgrub par mdzad do/ /de nas dgung lo nyer dgur phebs pa dpal gdeng ces pa chu mo bya'i lo'i dbyar e wam̐ du phebs nas bdag nyid chen pos gsol ba 'debs pa po'i gtso mdzad de/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dang mi gnyis pa'i thugs mnga' ba mtshungs med ri khrod pa chen po sku mched la sogs pa'i phyogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen sde snod dang rgyud sde 'dzin pa chen po du ma dang / chos dang srid kyi mdzad pa rmad du byung ba'i mi chen du mas thog grangs pa'i blo gsal zhing don du gnyer ba'i dge 'dun 'dus pa brgya phrag drug tu nye ba tsam zhig la 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal snga nas/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag bsal pa mtha' mchod cing rgyas la/ nyams len 'khyer bde zhing 'grel pa cha lag phra mo tshun dang bcas pa gdul bya so so'i 'dod pa dang mtshams par gnang / bdag nyid chen pos gnad kyi don rnams la zin bris cung zad kyang mdzad cing / gsung chos 'chad pa dang gsan pa ma gtogs mnyam bzhag la lhod pa med par mdzad pas nyams myong khyad par can du ma thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing / thun mtshams su gting skyes chos rje 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bkra shis pa sku mched kyis gtso mdzad/

dge 'dun tshogs pa la dpal sa skya pa gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum gyi lung dang / srod la zur bka' bgrang ba las 'das pa gnang / gsung ngag grol nas rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa nyis brgya lhag tsam mdzad de/ yab sras gnyis kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mor byed pa'i 'od la 'gran pa ltar mdzad la/ zang zing gi longs spyod bsnyen bkur 'bul nod kyi tshogs kyang rdzogs ldan gyi sprin lta bu byung bas da dus rang e wam̐ chos ldan pa dar rgyas che bar grags so/ /ston 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po sku mtshams dam pa la bzhugs te/ bdag nyid chen po dpal sa skya pa chen po'i dus dran gyi mchod pa'i ser phreng gi dbu la phebs zhing / dge 'dun rnams la ngan song sbyong rgyud nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang tshar kha yar la sogs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi char chen po phab nas slar rtse gdong la phebs so/ /dngos po'i lo zla ba dang po la 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdu ba'i tshul bstan nas/ bdag nyid chen po dang sku'i gcung rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa ches ngo mtshar ba du mas 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i 'dren pa dam par gyur pa ngag gi dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas te/ sku mched gnyis sku 'khor gyi tshogs du ma dang bcas pa zla ba gnyis pa'i yar tshes bdun brgyad skor la phebs/ de ma thag tu sku gdung rin po che'i drung du byin rlabs zhu ba la phebs te/ shing sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa lta bu'i sku lus brdabs pa'i phyag bgrang ba las 'das pa dang / ldog tu med pa'i spyan chab kyi phung po chu bo'i rgyun lta bu mdzad cing / snyan dar dkar me gdung 'bul la sogs stobs che bar phul/ dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i steng du mang ja bzang ba'i bsnyen bkur/ dge 'dun nyis stong du nye ba 'tshogs pa'i dge 'dun bcu re la gan gos kha re/ gos chen gyis ma khyed pa brgyad re la gan dar shin tu bzang ba kha re'i gral 'gyed dang /

che 'bul rnam gzhag bsngo rten sogs dngos po bzang zhing stobs che ba mdzad/ de nas brtsams te gang du bzhugs sar lo dus dang zla dus kyi mchod pa bla ma gzhan rnams las lhag tsam dang bcas pa ma chag par mdzad do/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/ yab sras chos kyi gtam la rjes chags pa'i/ /thugs ni mgon la gus pa'i nyams lhan zhing / /grags pa phyogs mtha' gsal ba'i rnam dkar gyis/ /mdzad mgrin dpyid kyi dpal la 'gran pa bzhin// //gnyis pa bstan pa'i bgyi ba rlabs po che mdzad tshul bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ thog mar gdan sa chen por mdzad tshul dang / yul dus gzhan du'ang ci rigs pa mdzad tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gang gi rnam dpyod shing rta las drangs pa'i/ /gong ma'i legs bshad nyin byed 'od zer gyis/ /chos min mun pa ming gi mthar mdzad nas/ /phan bde'i snang ba yongs su rgyas par mdzad/ /ces te/ zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes la gdan sa chen por phebs nas rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod mdzad/ gling dpon chen la sogs pa che dgu mang po la rdo rje phur pa'i dbang bka' dang / dkar bdud lcam dral gyi rjes gnang la sogs pa'i zab rgyas chos kyi bka' drin stsal te shin tu dad par mdzad/ dbyar de dpal sa skya yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas de nyid du gdan chags nas/ bslab gsum ngur smrig gi gos kyis mdzes pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen sdom brtson sde snod 'dzin pa du ma dang / bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i rnal 'byor la thugs gzhol ba'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis gsol ba btab nas/ rje btsun sa skya pa chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi 'khrul ba med pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pas gangs ri'i khrod 'di dge legs su mdzad pa'i rgyun deng sang gi bar du gnas pa rnams kyi nang nas gtso bor gyur pa stobs bcu'i dbang phyug dpal mgon bi rū pa'i bzhed gzhung gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang ste/

skal ldan gling bzhi'i dbus na legs par byas pa'i bsod nams gser gyi sa 'dzin gyi rtse mor/ phrin las nam mkha'i nor bu dang / snyan grags bdud rtsi'i 'od can gyis lus can mun pa'i lam las grol bar mdzad de/ rnam par grol ba'i lam dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i gnas su khrid par byed pa'i snyan brgyud kyi dga' ston stsal ba'i thog ma yin no/ /lo de nyid kyi ston gcig tu dben pa la thugs gzhol bar gyur te/ gangs ri dpal dang ldan pa'i phreng bas kun nas bskor zhing / sgra snyan par sgrog pa'i chu klung yid du 'ong ba 'bab pa'i ngogs/ lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu rnam par bkra ba'i byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong du sku mtshams rgyun ring du mdzad nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi bsnyen sgrub gtso bor gyur pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu bzhugs/ na tshod ldan gyi lo sku mtshams grol nas gdan sa chen por phebs te phur sgrub dang / gsung chos 'ga' zhig gnang / de nas e wam̐ du 'dren mchog chos kyi rje'i nang rten mjal ba la phebs/ dge 'dun tshogs pa la ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi bshad pa dang gzhan phan skor gsum gyi lung / dbang rjes gnang 'ga' zhig dang bcas pa gnang / snar thar du phebs nas steng dpon yum sras la rdo rje phur pa'i dbang bka' dang rjes gnang zab mo 'ga' zhig mdzad de/ rtse gdong gi dgon par rin chen sgang du phebs/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa zhwa lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang pos spyan drangs te/ tshe dpag med 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang / 'chi med kyi rang gzungs/ dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang / rnam sras zhi drag gi rjes gnang / ༈ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon kyi dkyil 'khor du byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ nges don gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su dbang gong ma/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang dang bcas pa rwa 'bre sa gsum gyi phyag len gcig tu byas pa/

dbang rjes gnang de rnams kyi yig cha'i lung / dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'grel shongs 'gyur la blo gros rnam gnyis kyis bcos pa/ lam zab rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid/ khrid yig dang ngo sprod bu ston rin po che dang chos rje phyogs pas mdzad pa/ dha shrī bas mdzad pa'i gsung bgros/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs che chung gnyis dang bcas pa gsan cing / mun khang lus gnad 'byed bcing sogs ji skad bshad pa bzhin mdzad pas thugs dges spro dang bcas te bsgoms pas/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs dang nyams myong bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs/ gzhan yang sgra'i bstan bcos ka lā pa/ lo chen nyid kyi 'grel pa/ de'i cha lag bying mdo/ uṇa rtsa 'grel/ tsan+d+ra pa lo chen rang gi 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ yi ge'i mdo/ nyer sgyur nyi shu'i 'grel pa/ byings le/ ting mtha'i 'grel pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'i byings mdo'i bsdus don/ ka lā pa'i sa bcad rnams kyi bshad pa'i sa gcod sa ris kyi lag len rnams legs par gsan cing / sdebs sbyor gyi bstan bcos rin chen 'byung gnas dang / nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bsdus don/ tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos me long / de'i 'grel pa dpang los mdzad pa/ nyid kyi mdzad pa'i gsal byed dang bcas pa gsan cing mkhyen/ mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos sna tshogs gsal ba'i nyer mkho bsdus pa gsan/ gzhan yang 'jam dbyangs dang / bde mchog dang / thub dbang dang / nag po chen po rnams kyi bstod pa 'gyur gsar rnying du ma dang bcas pa legs par gsan la/ gsan pa de dag kyang ming tsam ma yin pa/ tshigs dang don du bcas pa legs par dgongs shing thugs su chud pas phyi dang nang gi rig pa'i gnas thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab kyi 'dren byed rab tu gsal ba'i gnas lnga rigs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rtsod pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur pa yin te/ de yang bdag nyid chen po 'di'i mkhyen pa spyan zur lhung ba tsam gyis gzhung lugs rtogs sla ba rnams tshar re dang /

shin tu dka' ba rnams kyang zung re tsam gyis dgongs pas/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po dharma pa la bha dra thugs phrogs par gyur te/ tshe 'dir len re zung re thos tsam gyis/ gzhung lugs kun shes pa chos rje pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dang nges par gnyis su med pa'o zhes gsung zhing gus pa'i thal mo yang yang zum par mdzad do zhes thos so// //nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / 'gos lo dharmā pa la'i zhal snga nas/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur sa lugs dang / /jo zhal lugs kyi sbyor drug la sogs zhus/ /ka lā tsan+d+ra rin chen 'byung gnas dang / /sna tshogs gsal ba snyan ngag me long dang / /dpag bsam 'khri shing la sogs tha snyad kyis/ /gtsug lag phal cher zhus shing nan tan bgyis/ /rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur la sogs pa/ /dus dang don la 'jug tshul cung zad shes/ /saṃ skri ta dang bod kyi klog tshul la/ /snga rabs 'chad tshul rab tu mang na yang / /skyon med 'bri dang brjod pa'i tshul shes pa/ /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan 'di nyid bka' drin las/ /gzhan la 'chad dam rang nyid nyams su len/ /ji ltar byed kyang lag nom mi dgos tsam/ /zhes gsung ngo / /de dag la 'di skad ces/ sgra tshad bzo dang gso ba nang don rig /sdeb sbyor mngon brjod zlos gar tshig gi rgyan/ /brtsis sogs mkhas pa rnams la yongs grags pa'i/ /rigs gnas phal cher gzigs pa tsam gyis dgongs/ /khyad par nyi zla lta bu'i ka tsan gnyis/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum dpal ldan dus 'khor lo/ /zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa'i/ /gtsug lag kun la 'jigs med spobs pa thob// //gnyis pa yul dus gzhan du'ang ji ltar rigs par mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ snyigs dus 'gro ba'i tshogs gnyis rin chen las/ /legs grub mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar lhun po'i sku/ /mkhas mang rgya mtsho'i dbus su rtag bzhugs nas/ /thub bstan gling bzhi mdzes pa'i dpal du mdzad/ /ces te/ lo de'i mjug la rje btsun dam pa mus pa chen po'i bka' lung phebs shing /

nā len+da pa'i spyi sa nas spyan 'dren nan can byung ba la brten/ dpal rgyun gyi dbang po'i chos gyi grwa chen por phebs/ bu ram shing pa'i gsung rab dri ma med pa rnams kyi dgongs don rang dbang du 'grel pa la khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas nges pa'i mkhas grub chen po rong ston chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal tshab tu lha dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun gyis mnga' gsol te/ 'dzin byed ces pa me pho byi ba'i lo'i dgun gang du rin chen sgang du chos thog drangs pa'i khrid bka' du ma dang / gsung bka' grangs las 'das pa dang / byin rlabs dang / rjes gnang dang / lung la sogs pa nyin mtshan khor yug tu skyo dub med par gnang / sos ka dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i dbang dang / rdzogs rim shin tu spros med nyams khrid du gnang / dbyar mtshungs med dam pa rje btsun mus pa chen po na len+dar phebs/ bdag nyid chen pos gtso mdzad/ 'dus pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu la gsung ngag rin po che dang dbang byin rlabs mang du gnang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sum brgya tsam gyi mkhan slob mdzad de/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge 'dun sbyin bdag gi tshogs dang bcas pa dad cing gus par mdzad do/ /dbang phyug gi lo yab sras gnyis 'dar phyogs su phebs/ yar lam bdag nyid chen pos gzhis kha rnam sras gling du chag lo gsum pa mjal ba la phebs/ yang dag he ru ka mar me dgu pa'i dbang / dbang gi sgrol ma dang / lha mo te nu'i rjes gnang / bran bdud kyi rjes gnang la sogs pa gsan/ rje 'di dus kyi 'khor lo la shin tu mkhas shing sku btsun pa dang dam pa'i chos bzhugs rgya che ba la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi mdzod mnga' ba zhig 'dug pas/ dus 'khor gyi chos bskor yongs su rdzogs pa zhig zhu sems na'ang / sde 'khrug gi stas dbang gis ma grub ces gsung zhing / dad gus dang thugs mthong shin tu che bar mdzad do/ /de nas e wam̐ du phebs nas dge 'dun tshogs pa la mang ja gan gos re'i gral 'gyed dang bcas pa gnang nas dpal sa skyar phebs/

'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po'i nang rten du bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi gser sku khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa bzhengs pa'i dbu btsugs/ dge 'dun tshogs pa la gsung ngag rin po che dang / shin tu spros med dang / rgyud kyi bshad pa la sogs pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor/ dbyar lo e wam̐ du phebs nas sku mtshams dam pa zla ba phyed tsam mdzad/ dge 'dun rnams la saṃ bu ṭa/ rdo rje dbyings/ 'dus pa 'phags lugs/ 'khor lo sdom chen la sogs pa'i byin rlabs 'ga' zhig gnang / lhun grub rtse/ snar thang / seng ge rtse la sogs par yang ci rigs pas spyan drangs shing / glang stag gnyis la gtsang phyogs kho nar bzhugs/ sde 'khrug gi bar zhugs la sogs pa gang 'grub mdzad cing / gtso cher dad pa dang ldan pa'i skye bo rnams la so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa rgya chen po mdzad/ gser sku'i rab gnas la sogs pa legs par grub nas/ nā len+da pa'i gdan 'dren pa dang sdebs te/ myos ldan gyi lo ma shar tsam la shrī nā len+da'i chos gar phebs/ gsang 'dus dang kye rdo rje'i rgyud rtsa bshad la sogs pa'i chos bka' bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun ma chad par gnang zhing / mtsho kha dga' ldan rtser skal ldan rnams sbyor drug gi nyams khrid gnang / dbyar rten gsum bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i sman sku mda' gang tsam dang / de rnams dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi gser sku/ rten gyi gtso bo la 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i gser sku thog tshad ma rnams bzhengs te/ mchod pa'i yo byad tshar du mngar ba dang / na bza' dang / bzhugs gdan dang / sa rgyan gnam rgyan la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bkod/ cho ga rnam par dag pas rab tu gnas pa legs par mdzad de/ bkra shis dang byin rlabs kyi dpal gyi gzi 'od 'bar bar mdzad do/ /'brug lo rwa sgreng skor ba la phebs te/

byang 'brog gi skye bo shing ltar gyong ba rnams la skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed la sogs pa'i gang la gang 'dod kyi chos gsungs/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs dbang rjes gnang du ma gnang ste/ btsun pa rnams dam tshig dang sdom pa la bkod/ khyim pa rnams bsnyen gnas la bkod/ 'gro ba mang po la byang chub kyi sa bon btab/ rwa sgreng du phebs nas rten gsum rnams la phyag dang mchod pa rgya chen po mdzad/ smon lam dang sems bskyed mang du gnang nas/ yar phebs pa'i lam du bla ma dge dga' ba zhes pa'i sbyor drug gi thugs dam dang go myong bzang po yod pa zhig dus rtag tu bug sgo la bzhugs pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dngos su mjal ba yod pa'i mtshan ltas byung bas/ nye gnas la de ring su byung yang nga la ma gsang cig ces gsung / de nyin bdag nyid chen po dpon slob rnams phebs nas nye gnas kyis tshul zhus pas/ 'jam dbyangs dngos dang mjal ba da res tsam yin gsung nas bug sgo la yar 'dren byas/ dngos po thams cad phul nas chos 'brel zhus pas/ sems bskyed chen mo la sogs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig dang / zab chos dang man ngag zab mo kha yar gnang / ding sang bstan 'dzin thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan khyed gcig por 'dug kyang / dgung lo zhe lnga dang zhe dgu sku dog chen po 'dug pas sku tshe ring ba'i rten 'brel gnang dgos zhes zhu phul/ yang lam gyo sgrub chen pa'i slob ma sbal pa blo gros rgyal mtshan bya ba/ sbyor drug gi thugs dam shin tu smin pa zhig gi mnal lam du/ sa phyogs de na mchod rten chen po dril bu dang dar 'phan sna tshogs 'phyang ba/ sgo rnams na/ rigs lnga'i sku bzhugs pa gcig la mi mang po skor ba byed cing 'dug khong la mi gcig na re/ 'di'i nang na bka' 'gyur ro cog bzhugs pas bskor ba gsum byas na skor ba 'bum 'gyur du 'gro zer/ mi 'di tsam gyis bskor zhing steng du bsdad na 'gyel mi 'gro'am byas pas/

'di gang ltar byas kyang 'gyel mi srid zer/ sang nyin bdag nyid chen po der phebs pa la dad pa can mang pos mjal ba'i ngo mtshar gyi ltas su 'dug ces gsung zhing shin tu dad par mdzad/ phebs pa'i nub mo'ang dus 'khor thugs dkyil la bla ma brgyud pas bskor zhing / bla ma re re la'ang phag mo'i sku res 'khyud pa la sogs pa'i stong gzugs khyad par can du ma byung gsung nas dad gus ches che ba mdzad/ khyad par 'bab rong du phebs nas rten gsum mang po la rab gnas mdzad/ rnam g.yengs med pas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i bla ma 'bab rong pa chen po dang / sgom chen rnams la rang gi skal ba dang mtshams pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad/ de dus dgun yin kyang brag sreb na 'jam dbyangs me tog mang po 'khrungs 'dug pa/ bdag nyid chen po sa phyogs 'dir phebs pa'i ngo mtshar gyi ltas su 'dug ces thams cad gleng zhing dad par byed do zhes thos so/ /de nas slar na len+dar phebs te/ lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang chos kyi grags pas gtso mdzad lung rigs smra ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po la sangs rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po skor nas dpal sa skyar phebs/ don gnyer rnams la chos bka' ci rigs pa gnang / de nas mus bsam gtan phug tu phebs nas/ khyu mchog gi lo ngo gang la sku mtshams mdzad de/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin par mdzad/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang bum can gyi rnal 'byor mang du bsgom pas rdzogs rim gyi rtog pa khyad par can du ma thugs la 'khrungs/ sku mtshams grol nas rje btsun dam pa mus pa chen po la rdo rje phreng ba kri ya sa muts+tsha dang bcas pa'i dbang / bde mchog sdom pa'i chos skor rdzogs pa mgon po'i rtsub sgrub sogs kha cig gsan te/ mdor na rje btsun dam pa 'di'i drung du snga phyir gsan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs mdo tsam brjod na/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa yongs su rdzogs pa yab yum gyi phyi nang gi dbang dang byin rlabs/

rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi chos bzhi sogs cha lag phra mo tshun chad yongs su rdzogs pa/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar thor bu ba rnams dang / zhib mo rdo rje dang ngo mtshar snang ba/ lam 'bras glegs bam du bzhugs pa'i yig sna bzhi bcu zhe dgu tshang ma/ lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba che chung gnyis rnams gsan/ gzhan yang slob dpon chen po a bha yas bkral ba'i rdo rje phreng ba yongs su rdzogs pa/ kri ya'i dge legs kyi dkyil 'khor gsum gyi dbang dang bcas pa/ 'khor lo bde mchog grub chen lo nag dril gsum gyis bkral ba'i dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod dang bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs/ nag po rim bzhi/ rtsa dbu ma bde mchog dkar po rnams kyi rdzogs rim gyi khrid/ bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub/ gsang ba 'dus pa rigs gsum ka'i dbang / 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi dbang / kun rig sa lugs/ 'chi bdag 'joms pa/ sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis/ tshe dpag med lha dgu/ rigs gsum spyi dbang / grub rgyal ma rnams kyi dbang / 'chi med kyi rang gzungs/ sgrol ma/ gur mgon lha brgyad dang bcu gnyis dang dus sol lha mo/ zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ las gshin lha bcu gsum ma rnams kyi rjes gnang / 'jigs byed kyi dug dbang / rā pod phal cher gyi lung / rnal 'byor bzhi rim/ mgon po'i nang khrid dang man ngag mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis bsgrigs pa sogs mgon po'i chos skor du ma/ theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong / de'i yig skor sems dpa' chen po dpon slob kyis bsgrigs pa sogs blo sbyong gi chos skor yongs rdzogs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bdud kyi spyod yul khrid yig gnyis dang bcas pa/ rje btsun dam pa mus pa chen po nyid kyi bka' 'bum gyi lung la sogs pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos mang du gsan te/ nyid kyi zhal nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug bud+dha rat+na las/
