/sngags kyi gdams ngag phal cher skyar nas nyan/ /gzhan yang gsang 'dus rigs gsum blo sbyong gcod/ /kṛ ya sa muts+tsha sogs mang du thos/ /zhes gsung ngo / /dam pa'i chos gsan pa'i rnam grangs 'di dag ni/ rags pa tsam yin gyi/ rgyas par bdag nyid chen po'i gsan yig rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba las zhib tu 'byung bas der rtogs par bya'o/ /de rjes bdag nyid chen pos kyang sku'i gcung gsung bdag chen nam mkha' 'dod grub pa dang / bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis pa sku mched kyis gtso mdzad don gnyer gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma la dbang rjes gnang du ma dang / dpal sa skya pa gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum gyis lung la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa skor/ slar gdan sa chen po la phebs pa'i tshur lam/ rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po rnams kyi sprul pa'i sku du ma rim par byon pa'i gnas chen jo mo nang du phebs/ sku 'bum mthong grol chen po mjal/ phyag dang skor ba dang smon lam mang du mdzad/ sgrub chen pho mo rnams la chos 'brel la sogs pa gnang ste/ sna tshogs kyi lo gdan sa chen por phebs nas/ tshogs chen la gsung ngag rin po che dang / 'khor lo bde mchog gi smin grol cha lag dang bcas pa rnams dang / gzhi byes kyi grangs don gnyer can brgya phrag gsum lhag tsam la rdo rje phreng ba kri ya dang bcas pa'i dbang rgyas pa dang / zur bka' dang rjes gnang du ma'i chos kyi char chen po phab nas skal bzang gdul bya'i lo thog yongs su rgyas par mdzad/ mus kyi rdo dkar las grub pa'i lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa yongs su rdzogs par bzhengs te rab gnas rgyas par mdzad nas bzhis de dag tu bzhugs su gsol/ nyi ma'i lo snar thang sde pas spyan drangs nas/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag la sogs pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos bka' du ma gnang / de lo rgya nag la gtam 'bul ba rnams rdzong ba mdzad/

dbyar sos yon mchod lhan cig tu rje btsun dam pa mus pa chen po mjal ba la thub bstan yangs pa can du phebs te chos bka' ci rigs pa gsan/ bdag nyid chen pos gnyug mar gnas pa'i dpon slob rnams la tshogs chos dang / yab sras gnyis kyis rab byung bsnyen rdzogs zhag grangs du mar gnang / de nas seṅge rtser spyan drangs/ sde pa yab sras la dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin mang du stsal/ mi'i dbang phyug dam pa dpon blon rnams kyis dad gus chen pos/ gdan sa chen po la gtogs pa'i mi chen/ dpon skya/ brgya dpon/ bcu dpon/ las tshan kha bzhi/ rgyu ba kha gsum rnams sbyor gtong mdzad/ lha sde mi sde thams cad kyi bdag nyid chen po'i phyag phyi lugs mthun sgrub cing / gdan sa chen po'i spyi nus kho na byed/ sde pa dang dpon skya gzhan gyis dmag khral las gsum mi bskul bar spyi mchod du bzhugs pa chog pa'i zhabs tog phul/ stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rin dpung pa dpon blon la sogs pa thugs dgongs rnam par dkar ba'i sde srid gzhan nas kyang de nyid brtan pa'i mthun rkyen 'ba' zhig mdzad pa la brten/ dus phyis kyi zhal ngo khri thog tu bzhugs pa la/ bdag nyid chen po'i sku'i ring rang gdan sa mnga' thang che ba yin zhes gzu bor gnas pa rnams sgrog par byed do/ /ston snar thar du spyan drangs nas/ byang phyogs kha ba'i sman ljongs ku mu ta rnam par bzhad pa'i tshal du/ kun mkhyen thub pa mchog gi bstan pa'i nying khu byang chub kyi sems gnyis kyi nyams len rgyas par mdzad pa dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ de'i sras kyi thu bo 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi babs pa (gtum)rtum ston blo gros grags la sogs pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu brgyud mar byon pa'i chos kyi gdan khri mthon po la zhabs sen dbang gi rgyal po nye bar bkod nas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol lo/

/de'i dus bdag nyid chen pos yas bka' stsal ba'i tshul du bka' drin che ba'i dbang dang / bsngo ba'i yon bshad pa la sogs pa sngon chad mkhas pa gzhan gyi rna ba'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i bkod pa'i 'od zer du ma bkye ba/ mtho ris kyi mgon po'i lag sor las 'ong pa'i lha'i me tog man+d+ra rwa ba'i phreng ba du ma skabs gsum pa'i lam nas gtor te mngon par mchod do/ /de nas chos grwa der mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas gtso mdzad/ sde snod 'dzin pa brgya phrag du ma la slob dpon chen po a bha yas bkral ba'i sgrub thabs rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po skor/ slar gdan sar phebs nas dgun chos dang / dus rim chen mo mdzad/ gting skyes pa yum sras kyis gdan drangs te/ zhag grangs kha yar bzhugs nas dbang bka' rjes gnang 'ga' zhig gnang ngo / /nyi sgrol byed ces pa shing pho spre'u lo/ rje btsun dam pa mus pa chen po'i bkas bskul nas e wam̐ du phebs/ sku'i gcung yon tan rin chen du ma'i mdzod 'dzin pa tshe brtan nam mkha' 'dod grub pas gtso mdzad/ phyogs ris kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen sde snod 'dzin pa du ma dang bcas pa'i tshogs pa bzhi brgya lhag tsam la snga dro tshul bzhi rgyas pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyi rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma'i mchan bu dang rnam bshad nyi 'od kyi steng nas bshad pa mtha' spyod dang bcas pa/ phyi dro gsung ngag rin po che'i nyams len gyi gnad zab mo tshad ma bzhis rjes su 'brel ba'i yig cha rnams dang bcas pa/ srod la zur bka' bcu phrag lhag gcig byin rlabs dang rjes gnang du ma/ bdag cag 'ga' zhig la sgra'i bstan bcos ka lā pa'i ming lo yan gyi sa ris dang me long dang / 'grel la sogs tha snyad skor gyi phyag khrid/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi bshad pa sngags btu'i lag len byin rlabs dang bcas pa/

yum la brtan pa'i rtsa dbu ma sogs snyan brgyud kyi gdam pa zab la mang ba/ 'jigs byed rtog bdun dang rtog gsum gyi bshad pa/ sngags btu dang 'khor lo rnams kyi lag len/ dge bshes rags rim 'ga' la lam 'bras dang 'brel ba'i dbang byin rlabs/ sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa yan chod yongs su rdzogs pa/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs pa brgya lhag tsam la nges par 'byung ba'i dbang du byas pa'i sdom pa/ rgyu 'gul paṇa chen gyi gsung 'bum/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rab du ma'i lung dang bcas pa nyin mtshan khor yug du thugs skyo dub cung zad kyang med par dges spro dang bcas te gnang / sa ga zla ba'i yar tshe gcig la bdag chen rin po che nam mkha' 'dod (don)grub pa'i zhal snga nas/ lung rig smra ba'i khyu mchog lcags thang rab 'byams pas gtso mdzad/ tshogs pa thams cad la mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ dbang gong ma dang bcas pa/ rags bsdus bzhi bcu zhe lnga la rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang gnang / thun mtshams rnams su dpe khang nas/ rgya dpe rnams spyan drangs nas gzigs rtog zhib tu mdzad/ skabs zhig tu nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rje lo chen gyi bstod pa de sgra don dang mthun par legs sbyar gyi skad du bsgyur nas/ sdeb sbyor gyi prastā ra bkod pas/ lha rnams kyis me tog dkar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i tshogs kyis mngon par gtor te sa ris mdzad pa'i gaṇ+ḍi'i steng du mang du babs pas/ bstod pa de la lha rdzas ut+pal dkar po'i char 'bebs ces btags/ de dus thugs dam gyi skabs zhig la gzigs snang khyad par can 'ga' zhig byung ba'i bkod pa'i bris sku yod ces gleng ngo / /de dag la 'di skad ces/ sras bcas rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'i phrin las kun/ /legs bsdus kun dga' 'dren pa bzang po'i srol/ /rtsod bral mkhas pa'i mdun sar smra ba la/

/'jigs med spobs pa brnyes pa khyod gcig pu/ /'jam mgon gnyis pa'i mkhyen brtse'i zlos gar gyis/ /e ma 'dzam gling sa 'di skal bzang na/ /nges par 'dun pa'i brgya byin lag pa yis/ /gsum rtsen 'dun pas me tog ma gtor ram/ /legs bshad gtam gyis blo gsal mgu bskyed cing / /snyan grags pho nya srid rtser gtong mkhas pa'i/ /rje btsun 'di la lha brgyas 'du byed na/ /shes ldan su zhig gus pa lhur mi byed/ /de nas sa ga'i sgrub mchod mdzad nas gdan sa chen por phebs/ seng ge sde pas lha rtse rdzong du spyan drangs nas tshe dbang brgya tshar gnang / grub chen ga ya dha ra'i sgrub phug tu phebs nas mchod pa dang smon lam rgya chen po mdzad/ yar lam mang mkhar mu gu lung du phebs nas zhag gcig bzhugs/ rje 'brog mi lo tsā ba'i sku 'dra la na bza' dang mchod pa rgya chen po phul/ gzims khang la rgyal mtshan btsugs/ smon lam rgya chen po gnang / gdan sar phebs nas dbyar chos mdzad/ lugs gnyis la mkhyen pa'i spyan rab tu gsal ba'i mi'i dbang phyug dam pa zil gnon rdo rjes gzhis ka bsam grub rtser spyan drangs nas/ gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dbang dang / chos skyong che chung gi rjes gnang la sogs pa gsan/ de nas rtse gdong du phebs mtshams/ rje btsun dam pa mus pa chen po chos kyi dbyings su thim pa'i kha skad byung / de ma thag tu mus la bteg pas/ gzhan don la dgongs nas zhag bdun 'das pa tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin dgon par phebs/ zla ba gcig gi bar du 'khor lo bde mchog spyod pa'i rdo rje'i lugs kyi sgrub mchod dang / bde mchog rgyud nas bshad pa'i bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga mdzad/ dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i tshogs dbu la phebs/ bdag nyid chen pos kyang mang ja 'bul 'gyed sogs gya nom pa mdzad/ zla ba gcig nas sku gdung rin po che la sku dkyil la brten pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debs phul/

gzhan phan bdud rtsi nas bshad pa'i cho gas sbyin sreg 'bul ba'i cho ga mdzad/ gdung rus phal cher ring bsrel gyi gong bur gyur pa la mchod pa dang smon lam rgya chen po gnang ste/ rje btsun mchog gi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par mdzad cing / de nas kyang gang du bzhugs par zla dus kyi mchod pa ma chag par mdzad do/ /de nas shrī nā len+dar chibs kyi kha lo sgyur te tshes dgu der phebs/ dbyar chos la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag dang / rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang la sogs pa'i chos ci rigs pa zhig gnang / sa skyong gi lo gsar nas phyogs kyi gdul bya so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par gsung ngag rin po che'i nyams khrid dang / tshul bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i rgyud kyi bshad pa dang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs la sogs pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad par skor zhing khams phyogs la 'bul sdud pa rnams rdzong ba gnang / mtsho kha dga' ldan rtser dad gus dang ldan pa'i bu slob rnams la zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i nyams khrid la sogs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston rgya chen po stsal te/ 'phan yul phyogs kyi gdul bya rnams rnam par grol ba'i lam la bkod do/ /de nas gtsang phyogs la phebs nas dge sding mgon khang du yun ring du bzhugs te thugs dam zab mo dang chos skyong gi gtor 'bul rgya chen po mdzad/ de dus gzigs snang ngo mtshar can 'ga' zhig byung nas/ chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi bstod pa dang / lha mo'i bskang gso gnyis brtsams pa yin zhes gleng / khyi phag gnyis nas gtso cher gdan sa chen po kho nar bzhugs/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge 'dun dang phyogs ris kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyad par can du ma la lo re bzhin gsung ngag rin po che la sogs pa'i smin grol gyi lam du ma dang / rgyud kyi bshad pa dang /

dbang rjes gnang lung man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun ldan du gnang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po dang blo gsal don gnyer can 'ga' zhig la so so'i 'dod pa dang mthun par sgra'i bstan bcos ka tsan gyi sa ris la sogs pa'i phyag khrid gnang / glo bo nas mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag nas rgya dpe phul te/ gsar du sgyur gcig pa'i bkas gnang nas/ sku gzugs kyi phyag tshad kyi mdo dang / yul shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi nyin byed kyis mdzad pa'i mgon po phyag gnyis pa'i bstod pa me tog phreng 'dzin gyi sdeb sbyor yod pa zhig rnams gzhi 'gyur du mdzad/ skabs 'gar sgo rum gzims khang du rim gnyis zab mo'i thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs shing / thun mtshams su gam+li ma hā kā la'i drung du mchod gtor 'bul ba dang / dpe khang chen po'i phyag dpe rnams la gzigs rtogs mdzad pa la sogs pa'i slad du sku mtshams pa snga phyi lan mang du mdzad/ kun 'dzin gyi lo rtse gdong du phebs nas gsung ngag rin po che la sogs pa'i/ zab rgyas kyi chos du ma gnang / slar gdan sa chen por phebs nas dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston ci rigs par stsol bar mdzad/ snga gong nas mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas yar phyogs su hor la sogs pa'i nyer 'tsho mang pos thugs sod mi sod pa'i lo rgyus dang / yab sras mjal 'dod pa'i bka' shog yang yang byung ba la brten/ thabs kyis gdan 'dren zhu bar lan kha yar gnang / phebs pa brtsams pa na/ yar phyogs kyi gdul bya rnams kyi cho nge drag pos sa phyogs gzhan du mi phebs par zhu phul nas phebs ma thub/ slar bdag nyid chen po yar la spyan 'dren zhu ba'i bkod pa shar te/ brag dkar gdan sa pa gdan 'dren la gnang byung nas/ sa mo glang gi lo dpon g.yog rags bsdus mdzad de chag bteg la stod lhor phebs pa na/ lho pa'i bdag po sa skyong gu ru rat+na bha drwa zhes bya bas lhun grub rab brtan du spyan drangs nas dbang dang byin rlabs zhus/

tsan+dan las grub pa'i las 'bras brgyud pa'i sku tshang mas thog drangs/ bsnyen bkur 'bul nod ches che bar mdzad/ de nas ding rir phebs mtshams/ stod na hor 'jigs shin tu che ba 'dug pa'i pho nya byung nas/ sku 'khor kun gyis zhu phul te phyir phebs/ ding rir rje btsun dam pa rgya gar gyi sku la mjal te smon lam dang thugs bskyed mdzad/ rim gyis gdan sa chen por phebs/ dbyar chos mdzad nas byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag tu phebs/ sku 'khor nyung shas gcig mdzad nas lo gcig 'khyud skor sku mtshams gnang / dpal kye rdo rje/ bde mchog nag po pa/ rdo rje phur pa/ chos skyong che chung / rnam rgyal 'joms/ dmar po skor gsum/ rdo rje lha mo rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub/ kha gso'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mdzad/ bar skabs zhig tu sku khams cung zad bsnyel ba na/ gnod sbyin zhig klag ltar byung / dka' tshegs che tsam gyi ngos nas sel yod ces gsung zhes gleng / de dus thugs dam gyi skabs zhig la/ sngon rje btsun rin po ches bzhengs pa'i mchod rten zhig la dpon slob rnams kyis zhig gsos mdzad de/ bdag nyid chen pos kyang sa rdo bskyed pa sogs mdzad pas/ nyin gcig sku 'khor rnams la khyod tshos e mthong / chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta phebs 'dug ces gsung zhing / nam mkha' la gzigs nas dad gus kyi shugs drag pos rnam 'gyur mang du mdzad kyin 'dug khong rnams kyis bltas pas nam mkha' dwangs pa la 'ja' 'od zlum po'i ri mo ngo mtshar can du ma 'dug gzhan ni ci yang ma mthong de bzhin zhus pas/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i thabs la 'bad pa thon ces gsung ngo / /zhes de dus zhabs drung na gnas pa'i sku 'khor rnams las thos so/ /de nas stag lo dbyar sos sku mtshams grol nas/ gdan sa pa rnams kyi dga' spro chen pos bsu ba'i bkod pa du ma dang bcas te spyan drangs/ phur sgrub dang dbyar chos la sogs pa mdzad/

gdung brgyud rin po che sku mched dang / dri ma med pa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang po slob dpon bkra shis brtan pa dpon slob rnams kyis gtso mdzad/ gzhi byes kyi don gnyer rnams la gsung ngag rin po che la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po skor/ ston bdag gis kyang zhabs drung du sleb ste dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa dang / sbyor drug gi khrid bka' la sogs pa 'ga' zhig gsol ba btab pas/ thog mar 'jigs byed bcu bdun ma/ zhe dgu ma/ gshin rje gdong drug rnams kyi dbang bka' dang / mgon po'i chos skor 'ga' zhig gur saṃ gyi mchan bu sogs lung gi tshogs kha yar 'chag med rnams kyi kha gso dang bcas pa gnang / dgun chos dang dus rim chen mo mdzad/ lcags yos kyi lo tshes nas tshogs chen la gsung ngag rin po che cha lag phra mo dang bcas pa dang / don gnyer gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzhi bcu tsam la mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel chen po'i bshad pa/ lnga bsdus sgra gcan gza' lnga dus sbyor dang bcas pa'i sa ris rnams gnang / rgyud 'grel grol nas/ nag pas nya ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs nas/ gdung brgyud rin po che ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pas gtso mdzad/ dge 'dun nyis brgya lhag tsam cig la rwa 'bro sa gsum gyi phyag len gcig tu byas pa'i dbang bdun/ nges don gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang gong ma dang bcas pa/ nya'i nyin rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang rnams gsan par gnang zhing / rdzogs rim gyi rtog pa don du gnyer ba rnams la zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i nyams khrid rigs ldan brgyud pa'i phyag len ji lta ba bzhin du gnang ste/ nges don gyi bstan pa nyin mo'i dpal la 'gran pa bzhin du mdzad do//

//de yang ji skad du/ 'di ni dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha yi mchog gis brgyud pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi rigs ldan te/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur byin nas mtha' dag thub pa'i rigs rnams dag ni rigs gcig dag tu byed par 'gyur/ /yang dag theg par mngon 'dzegs lha min rigs la 'jigs ster dpal ldan grags pa phyag na mdung thung can/ /sems can rnams kyi thar pa'i slad du sa la dus kyi 'khor lo rab tu gsal bar byed par 'gyur/ /zhes gang gsungs pa de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa'i rjes su bsnyegs pa'o/ /gzhan yang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rje sa chen la gnang ba'i blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral/ nā ro pa'i thugs kyi nying khu rtsa dbu ma/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor bzhi rim/ rwa rtse sems 'dzin rnams kyi khrid/ rwa pod yongs rdzogs kyi lung / dbus pa dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed skor gyi lung / rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i bka' 'bum pod bzhi ma'i lung / ngan song sbyong rgyud nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang / mtshan brjod rtsa 'grel gyi bshad pa la sogs pa'i zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad par bskor ro/ /dbyar smad nas bla brang rin chen sgang gi gzims khang du bug sgo 'dag sbyar can mdzad nas rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor la skad cig kyang g.yel ba med par bzhugs dus ring zhig nas la stod lho'i sa skyong chen pos dad gus chen pos spyan 'dren gyi gsol ba btab nas zhal gyis bzhes/ yar phyogs la ma phebs pa'i gong rol zhig tu mkha' spyod gzims chung sbug ma na bzhugs pa'i dus zhig mtshan lam du/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ 'jam dbyangs yin snyam pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta'i cha lugs byas pa cig chos rje sa paṇa/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa rnams chos kyi bgro ba mdzad pa'i drung du nga sleb/

the tshom mang du bcad/ khyad par nag po spyod pa ba las bde mchog gi chos skor ma lus pa thob/ gzhung drug rdzogs mtshams su gnyid sad pa'i snang ba byung gsung zhes drung na gnas pa dag las thos so/ /de nas dpon g.yog rags bsdus mdzad de la stod lhor phebs/ sa skyong chen po la bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dbang dang / rdzogs rim zab mo shin tu spros med kyi khrid la sogs pa'i chos bka' du ma gnang / de dus snga dro thugs dam grol mtshams cig da nang tho rangs bram ze'i gzugs ral pa'i khrod na seng ldeng gi rdo rje rtse lnga pa yod pa zhig byung ste/ khyod rang gi mi 'phrod yod do zer nas ban+de dbyar zhags gyon pa gnyis byung ba'i snang ba byung / phyi na mar ltos shog dang gsung / sde pa'i brgya sgo phye 'phral bltar phyin pas 'bul sdud pas btang yin zer ba'i gle'u gyon pa gnyis sgo drung na sleb 'dug ces gleng / phebs lam shrī rgod tshang du byon nas zhag gnyis bzhugs/ sgrub pa pho mo rnams la tshogs chas gser zho do gnang / gdan sar phebs nas sku mtshams cung zad mdzad/ 'bul sdud pa rnams kyang nyes pa med par zhabs drung du sleb ste dngos po thams cad phul/ tshogs chen la mang ja ja'i 'gyed dang bcas pa dang / gdan sa'i zhabs tog gtso bor mdzad pa'i che dgu rnams la ja gsar gyi gnang sbyin mtshon re mdzad/ de nas brtsams te rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug brtse ba chen po'i zla dus kyi mchod pa la tshogs chen la mang ja dang / bdag nyid chen po'i rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi zla mchod la dge bshes sum cu skor la gsol ja'i bsnyen bkur ma chag pa gnang / dga' ba'i lo tshes nas/ bdag chen rin po che khu dbon pas gtso mdzad/ tshogs chen la gsung ngag rin po che dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen thos bsam gyi rgyud phyug pa du ma la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa ba'i rgyud ṭī ka mu tig phreng ba'i steng nas nges pa'i don la 'bab cing gzhol ba'i bshad pa rgyas par mdzad/

phyogs ris kyi don gnyer can rnams la dbang rjes gnang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs la sogs pa nyin mtshan khor yug tu gnang / de dag gi skabs zhig tu/ thugs dam mdzad dus khyed rnams phyir song / brda' ma byung bar du su yang ma gtong gsung nas thugs dam la sngar las rgyun ring bar bzhugs/ gzims dpon gyis thugs dam grol yun ring ba 'di sku khams nyog pa min lags sam gus pas/ nyog pa med/ da nang bde ba can yin zer ba'i zhing khams yid du 'ong ba zhig tu sleb/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med la sangs rgyas byang sems mang pos bskor ba dang / rje sa skya pa yab sras/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen rnams kyang bzhugs 'dug de rnams kyi drung na rin po che'i khri shin tu mdzes pa gnyis 'dug pa'i cung mtho ba mtha' skor du mchod pa'i lha mang pos mchod rdzas thogs nas bskor ba/ steng na gdugs phugs pa zhig 'dug pa der khyod sdod zer/ ngas bsdad/ cung dma' ba der gzhan zhig phebs rgyu yin pa'i mtshan don byung ba brjed 'dug de yang dus khams stong par yod/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi drung du chos mang du thob/ zhing khams de las yid du 'ong ba mi 'dug gsung / nan gyis tshul gnang zhus pas gnyid sad pa'i snang ba byung gsung ba las gzhan bka' lung ci yang ma byung / zhes gleng / de nas ha cang rgyun mi ring ba zhig na glo bor mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i kha skad kyi pho nya sa ga zla ba'i nyer lnga la sleb ste/ thugs dgongs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ nyer brgyad kyi bar du nyin re bzhin bla ma mchod chog mkhyen pa thams cad bsags nas ja bur gyi bsnyen bkur dang / nyer dgu'i nyin tshogs chen la mang ja gral 'gyed dang bcas pa mdzad cing / de nas kyang zla dus kyi mchod pa ma chag par mdzad do/ /de nas rin chen sgang gi gzims khang du phebs nas/ lha chen pa nang so nam mkha' don grub pa la gsung chos zab mo 'ga' zhig gnang ste/

shin tu dben pa'i bug sgo 'dag sbyar can mdzad nas zab mo'i rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu bzhugs/ de dus bdag chen chos kyi rje kun dga' bkra shis pa dpon g.yog dang / de'i gcung bdag chen rin po che rin chen rgyal mtshan pa dpon g.yog stobs che ba gsung gi bdud rtsi nod pa la phebs/ bug sgo bsang nas bzhi thog gzims khang du phebs nas mjal 'phrad gnang / sku mched rnams kyi mang ja dang 'bul 'gyed la sogs pa stobs che ba mdzad/ bdag nyid chen pos kyang sku mched gnyis kyi gtso mdzad tshogs pa spyi la gsung ngag rin po che dang / rags bsdus don gnyer can rnams la 'khor lo bde mchog lo nag gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ dpyid thig gi khrid/ nag 'bum dang gzhung drug gi lung rdzogs pa/ 'jigs byed dang dmar po skor gsum la sogs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mang du gnang / khyad par tha skar gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i snga dro bris sku mang po la rab gnas kyi cho ga dang / phyi dro bdag chen rin po che rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa dpon g.yog 'ga' zhig la bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa gnang bas 'og min gyi mthar thug pa'i lha rnams kyis lha'i me tog gyi phreng bas sa'i dkyil 'khor 'di khyab par gtor te mngon par mchod cing / de nas kyang zhag grangs du ma'i bar du me tog gi char chen po 'bab par mngon no/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/ sngon byon mkhas grub mang pos nyer bsten pa'i/ /bgrang yas chos kyi khri la mnga' mdzad nas/ /blo gsal mang po'i re ba bskong mkhas pa'i/ /mgon khyod gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po nyid/ /blo gros lus dkar gangs ri'i rjes 'gro zhing / /gzhung mang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i goms stabs can/ /stong phrag mkhas btsun bzang po'i khyu mchog gis/ /gus pas bteg khyod lnga rig paṇ+ḍi ta/

/chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gyis mdzes pa'i/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i khang bzang nyams dga' bar/ /bsnyengs bral thos bsam bsgom pa'i khrir 'khod nas/ /ston pa'i rgyal sa 'dzin khyod 'od srungs che/ /phyi rig gling chen bzhi la dbang sgyur zhing / /nang rig lhun po'i rtse legs bgrod mkhas pa'i/ /'phags nor rin chen bdun la dbang 'byor khyod/ /skal bzang chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur dbang po/ /ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i bkod pa sna tshogs kyis/ /mtha' yas gdul bya yongs su smin mdzad pa'i/ /rnal 'byor dbang po rnams dang lhan cig tu/ /zab mo sgrog khyod grub pa'i dbang phyug che/ /yid 'ongs mtshan dpe'i ri mo rnam bkra ba'i/ /thub chen rgyal ba'i zhal gyi ltad mo ni/ /skyon bral thugs kyi me long ngos yangs por/ /nges par gzigs khyod sa thob sems pa che// //gsum pa mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan bye brag tu bshad pas don bsdu ba la gsum ste/ mkhas pa dang / btsun pa dang / bzang ba'i yon tan no/ /dang po la rgyu 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mkhas pa'i yon tan dang / 'bras bu mkhas grub kyi slob ma ji ltar byung ba'i tshul lo/ dang po ni/ mkhyen rab lang 'tsho rgyas pa'i mdzes sdug dang / /sngon med 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i skye mched kyis/ /khengs ldan mang po'i dregs pa 'phrogs mkhas pa'i/ /dbyangs can mgrin par thob pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes te/ de yang bdag nyid chen po 'di ni/ yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi zhal gyi bum bzang las 'ong ba'i phyi dang nang gi rig pa'i gnas kyi bsdus pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi bdud rtsi rnams/ rnam dpyod yangs pa'i snyim pas yang yang gsol ba/ blo gros ro 'dzin gyis dbang pos dges par myangs pas/ lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi bcud kyis sku gsung thugs kyi dbang po yongs su brtas par gyur nas/ slar yang 'gro ba rnams 'chi ba med pa'i gnas su phyin par byed pa'i bstan pa'i bdud rtsi de nyid yun ring du mi nub cing gnas par gyur cig snyam du dgongs pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa kho nas dbang byas nas/

phyogs dang ris med pa'i gdul bya blo gsal zhing don du gnyer ba'i dad 'dun can rnams la dam pa'i chos 'chad pa gtso bor gyur pa'i mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum gyis nyin mtshan khor mo yug 'da' bar mdzad la/ de'i tshul yang / snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can dmus long dmigs bu stor ba lta bur gyur pa rnams la thugs brtse ba'i shugs drag pos gzigs te/ rjes su 'dzin par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa bzang pos nye bar bshams pa'i chos kyi khri ga la bar zhabs zung 'khor lo'i ri mo can rnam par bkod nas sku'i dkyil 'khor drang por bsrangs te bzhin ras bzang po zla ba rgyas pa lta bu la 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyi rnam par bkra shing / gzhan la phan par gzhol ba'i mdzes pa'i spyan ut+pal lta bus 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la dal bur gzigs nas zab cing yangs pa'i shes bya'i gnas thams cad la gsal zhing ma nor bar spyod pa'i mkhyen rab kyi 'jug pa rnon pos/ bshad par bya ba'i chos gang yin pa de nyid tshig sna bar snyan cing brjid la zur thon pa dang / don go bde zhing chod che la tshig don mtshungs par ldan pa dang / dka' ba'i gnas rnams dpyis phyin cing byed pa gsal ba'i sgo nas so so'i blo dang mtshams par bshad pas/ gdul bya rnams kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal nas blo gros kyi chu skyes rab tu rgyas par mdzad pa la shin tu mkhas pas/ nyin rang po chos kyi grwar gnas kyang gus pas nyan par 'dod pa kho na las skyo ba dang dub pa mi 'byung zhing / gnyid rmugs dang rnam g.yengs kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar myong bas grub la/ ji snyed bshad pa'i rnam grangs yang / thog mar rgyud sde dri ma med pa rnams bshad pa'i dbang bskur mdzad pa la spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ spyi'i dbang bskur ni dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dpon a bha ya ka ra gup+tas bkral ba'i dpal rdo rje phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dang /

de'i steng du grub pa'i slob dpon chen po dar+pan ā tsar+yas lhag por bkral ba'i kṛ ya sa pa muts+tsha'i dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum ste bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i dbang dang / ngan song sbyong rgyud nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang dang / bye brag so so'i dbang la kye rdo rje'i bka' babs mi 'dra ba bzhi/ lus dkyil gyi dbang / rdo rje bdag med ma/ gur rigs bsdus/ sam+bu ṭa/ rdo rje dbyings/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ 'khor lo sdom chen/ mgon po lha bcu gnyis ma dang brgyad ma/ bde mchog lo nag dril gsum gyi lugs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ cha rdo ba'i zhal can/ dril bu lha lnga/ la wa pa'i bcu gsum ma/ ma hā ma ya/ sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga/ sgrol ma bla med/ sgrol ma lus dkyil/ 'khor lo chen po gsang 'dus lugs gsum/ gshed dmar lha lnga/ bcu gsum ma/ 'jigs byed sa lugs/ rwa lugs bcu gsum ma/ ro langs brgyad skor/ skyo lugs bcu bdun ma/ zhang lugs kyi zhe dgu ma/ gdong drug rwa lugs/ dgra nag zhang lugs/ sa lugs kyi yang phur gnyis/ kun rig 'chi bdag 'joms pa/ ku ru kul+le lha lnga/ 'od zer can lha lnga/ rnam 'joms ma ṇi badz+ra gyi lugs/ rigs gsum spyi dbang / a ra pa tsa na lha lnga/ gdugs dkar can/ gzungs grwa lnga/ mi 'khrugs pa/ tshe dpag med/ lha dgu ma lugs gnyis/ pad+ma thod phreng stsal te zur bka' lnga bcu rtsa gcig gzhan yang rdo rje bdag med ma'i byin rlabs la sogs pa lam 'bras dang 'brel ba'i byin rlabs bcu phrag gcig bsam mi khyab/ yi ge med pa/ dril bu rim lnga/ bde mchog dkar po/ rtsa dbu ma rnams kyi sngon 'gro'i byin rlabs/ sa lugs kyi phag mo skor gyi byin rlabs re re/ dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum/ phag dkar gyi byin rlabs/ yab yum gyi go cha'i byin rlabs gnyis te rgyud sde zab mo rnams nas bshad pa'i byin rlabs nyi shu rtsa gnyis lhag cig

sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho ste rjes gnang gi bka' srol chen po gnyis dang / gzhan rjes gnang zur bka' bzhi bcu lhag gcig dang / phur pa'i drag po'i rjes gnang / 'jigs byed kyi dug dbang dang / tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i dbang du grags pa rnams mdzad/ gzhan yang kye rdo rje'i rgyud gsum/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ ma hā ma ya/ 'jigs byed rtog bdun dang rtog gsum/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ mtshan brjod sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs/ dpa' bo sdu ba/ steng phyogs tshe dpag med kyi gzungs la sogs pa rgyud sde rin chen du ma dang / de dag gi dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos du ma'i bshad pa dang / zab mo lam skor dgu/ lam zab/ lam sbas bshad/ sbyor drug bde mchog dkar po/ dpyid thig rim bzhi/ rim lnga/ yab yum la brten pa'i rtsa dbu ma gnyis/ spros med/ rwa rtse sems 'dzin/ mtshan ma gyen bsgreng / mtshan mo rgyu ba/ rnal 'byor rim bzhi/ mgon po'i nang khrid gnyis/ zhen pa bzhi bral/ theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong la sogs pa khrid bka' du ma dang / chos bka' de rnams dang 'brel ba'i yig cha phran mang po dang / glegs bam du ma'i bshad lung dang / dpal sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi bka' 'bum/ rje rdo rje 'chang chen po yab sras kyi bka' 'bum/ rgyu 'gul paṇ+ḍi ta yab sras kyi bka' 'bum la sogs pa'i lung gi tshogs rab tu mang po dang / sgra dang / snyan ngag dang / sdeb sbyor dang / skar rtsis la sogs pa don dang tha snad kyi skor gyi phyag khrid dang / lo re bzhin rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa grangs las 'das pa dang / skye bo mang po la byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga thun mong ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa gnyis dang / rgyal sras lam bzang dang / bslab dpyod dang sdom pa nyi shu pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya ston pa'i gzhung du ma'i bshad pa dang /

lung la sogs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs re re nas kyang lan grangs du ma zhig stsol bar mdzad de/ mdor na bdag nyid chen po 'di'i gsan yig chen mo na bzhugs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs phal che ba lan re ma grub pa med ces gsung la/ ji snyed gsung ba de dag kyang / de ma thag tu 'chad pa las snga blta la sogs pa'i 'bad pa mdzad mi dgos shing / cung zad mdzad pa rnams kyang chos de nyid khungs tshad ldan dang / rgya dpe sogs la gtugs te dka' ba'i gnas rnams dpyis ma phyin gyi bar du 'doms pa mdzad la/ spros pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag dag rnams kyis tshig dang don gyi cha rtogs dka' ba'i gnas su gyur pa rnams la zhus shing rtsod pa'i tshe na/ thugs shin tu dges shing 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas pas de'i lan mod rgyud bstan bcos dang mthun pa'i lung dang / sgra tshad dngos stobs dang mthun pa'i rig pa'i 'od zer mtha' yas pa stsal bas/ gzhan dag gis ma rtogs pa dang / log par rtogs pa dang / the tshom gyi mun pa stug po drung nas 'byin pa la/ pha rol gyis dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa mnga' bas/ gzhan du lo zlar nyan pa bas kyang / bdag nyid chen po'i drung du chos thun kha yar nyan pa'am/ dogs gcod cung zad zhus pa blo bskyed che zhing blo la 'jags pa 'ong bar myong bas grub cing / dus mnyam pa'i blo gros can rnams kyi thugs la'ang gsal lo/ /gzhan yang bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa dang / dngos dang brgyud pa'i slob ma don du gnyer ba rnams la 'phral dang yun du phan par bya ba'i slad du/ mkhas pas yang dag sbyar ba yi/ /ngag dang ngag gi 'dod 'byor bshad/ /ces pa ltar rtsom pa po mkhas pas brtsams pa'i bstan bcos rnams kyi mngon par 'dod pa'i don bde blag tu rtogs pa'i phyir/ legs bshad gsar du mdzad pa la/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams la mchod yar gyi tshigs bcad/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams bzhi la bstod pa re re/

lam 'bras/ spros med/ sha ba ri'i sbyor drug phur pa/ kun rig mi 'khrugs pa/ gu ru drag po rnams kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ bde mchog brgyud 'debs chen mo'i kha bskong / zhu ba po so so'i ngor/ nyid dang nyid kyi slob ma dang chos 'chad pa mang po la bstod pa'i tshogs du ma/ bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga che chung gnyis/ rje btsun dam pa mus pa chen po dang / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar/ nyid kyi gsan yig rin po che pad+ma rwa ga'i phreng ba/ kyai rdo rje/ bde mchog dus 'khor/ rdo rje phur pa rnams kyi sgrub thabs/ yang phur dang pad+ma thod phreng stsal gyi sgrub dkyil gyi gsal byed/ spros med dang bde mchog dkar po'i khrid yig gi gsal byed/ rig byed ma'i bskyed rdzogs nyams su len tshul/ bir bsrung dang bla ma rin 'byung gi nyams len byed tshul sogs nyams len gyi gnad zab mo du ma/ 'dod lha so so'i rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs che chung kha yar/ bka' bsrung rnams kyi gtor chog dang lha mo'i bskang gso chen mo sogs chos skyong gi skor mang po/ lnga bsdus sgra gcan gza' lnga dang bcas pa'i rtsis gzhi/ thos bsam bsgom gsum ma nor bar byed tshul gyi zhal lta'i tshigs bcad/ rje btsun rin po che'i bstod pa'i tshig don la dogs gcod/ phrin yig dang gdams pa'i skor du ma/ dus 'khor gyi phyi nang gzhan gsum sbyar ba'i maṇ+ḍal sogs pa sngon med pa'i legs par bshad pa glegs bam du longs par mdzad cing / de dag kyang ming mngon brjod kyi spras pa bying che/ tshig snyan ngag gis brgyan pas sna bar snyan/ don brjod bya dang 'brel bas rtogs sla/ gcod mtshams sdeb sbyor dang mthun pas brjod bde ba la sogs pa bstan bcos rtsom po'i yon tan thams cad tshang bas mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog par byed pa kho na yin no// //de dag la 'di skad ces/ gzhung brgya 'chad pa'i lce bde blo gsal zhing /

/lung rig 'gal 'grel dpyod pa'i 'dren byed spangs/ /sdebs legs brtsom pa'i ro 'dzin sgyur mkhas pa'i/ /gnas lnga rig pa dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /blo bzang khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i ded dpon gyi/ /mkhas grub zhal gyi chu gter las blangs pa'i/ /dbang lung man ngag yid bzhin rin chen chos/ /zab yangs thugs kyi bang mdzod legs bkangs nas/ /slar yang skye dgu'i dbul ba bsal ba'i phyir/ /rgyud sde rnam bzhi dgongs don rin chen mchog /rdo rje phreng ba kṛ ya sa muts+tshar/ /legs par bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor zhe lnga dang / /ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu dang gnyis/ /rnam dag zur bka' lnga bcu rtsa gcig ste/ /smin byed dbang gi rnam grangs brgya dang brgyad/ /grol byed khrid kyi rim pa nyi shu bdun/ /snyan brgyud zab mo'i byin rlabs nyer gnyis lhag /rjes su gnang ba'i bka' srol chen po gnyis/ /rjes gnang zur bkar grags pa bzhi bcu lhag /rgya bod mkhas pa'i dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i/ /zab rgyas rgyud sde'i bshad pa bcu gsum dang / /so thar byang sems sdom pa bslab byar bcas/ /sgra dang snyan ngag sdeb sbyor skar rtsis dang / /bka' dang bstan bcos glegs bam rab 'byams kyi/ /dag gsal lung gi bka' drin dang bcas pa/ /mtha' yas gdul bya'i bsams pa ji lta bar/ /stsol mdzad chos kyi sbyin bdag che ba po/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sar 'gal 'grel gtam byed tshe/ /lung rigs rjes su gdams pa'i mche sder gyis/ /ma rtogs log rtog the tshom glang po'i lus/ /'joms mdzad smra ba'i seng ge tshugs pa med/ /legs sbyar tshig gi srad bu la brgyus pa'i/ /rgyan dang mngon brjod sdeb sbyor nor bu'i phreng / /mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog dbyangs can mgul pa'i rgyan/ /spel mkhas tshig rje tshig bdag smra mkhas pa// //gnyis pa 'bras bu mkhas grub kyi slob ma ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ sngon sbyangs spobs pa'i chu 'dzin stug po las/

/dus su 'doms pa'i legs gsungs dbyar skyes rnga/ /ring nas bos pa'i skal bzang rma bya rnams/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i char gyis tshim par mdzad/ /ces te/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni rigs kyi yon tan rkyang pas khyad par byas pa ma yin par/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi shes bya'i gnas ma lus pa gsal bar dgongs shing / brtse ba'i thugs rjes 'gro ba rnams bu gcig pa lta bur skyong la/ mdzad pa'i phrin las kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i snyan pa'i grags pas rgya mtsho'i gos can 'di yongs su khyab par gyur pa la brten nas skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams mnyes gshin pa'i bus ma snyeg pa ltar/ ma bsdus par yang rang gi ngang gi 'du zhing / khyad par du yang bdag nyid chen po 'di'i gsung gi bdud rtsi ngoms par gsol ba dang / chos kyi 'brel pa ci rigs pa thob pas kyang dad pa dang blo gros kyi dbang po yongs su rgyas par gyur pas 'khor gyi thog mar khas 'che ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa yang / gangs ri'i khrod kyi skye dgu thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu'i khri la zhabs zung mngon par bkod nas/ bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag dam par bzhugs pa sku'i gcung 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas sku mched khu dbon rnams dang / mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan du ma la dbang 'byor ba'i bdag chen rin po che kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba sku mched rnams dang / mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan du mas brgyud phyug pa brag dkar ba sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan du ma la dbang 'byor bas skye dgu mang po'i skyabs gnas su gyur pa mkhan chen shes rab dpal ldan pa dang / zab mo'i lam gyis rang rgyud smin par byas nas gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa la mkhas pa gser gling chos rje kun dga' bkra shis pa dang /

zab rgyas chos kyi mdzod bzung nas blo gsal mang po'i rwa ba skong bar mdzad pa bzhi sde chos rje 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa dang / mdo dang sngags kyi gzhung lugs du ma la mkhyen pa'i spyan rab tu yangs pa thub bstan yangs pa can gyi chos rje rnam gnyis dang / gsung rab rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa'i mkhas grub chen po don grub dpal 'bar ba yab sras dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros can lcags thang rab 'byams pa dang / tshul khrims kyi phung po la nyes ltung gi dri mas dben pa lo pa spyan snga chos kyi grags pa dang / chos dang srid kyi bya ba la mkhyen pa'i spyan rab tu gsal ba chos rje sku skye ba ngag dbang grags pa dang / mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshig don la mkhyen pa rab tu rgyas pa lhun sdings lo tsā ba nam mkha' dpal bzang pa sku mched dang / 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad ngan skyugs kyi phung po ltar gzigs nas/ gcig tu dben pa la thugs gzhol ba byang pa dus 'khor ba dpal bzang po dang / skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi rigs su 'khrungs nas 'gro ba mang po'i 'dren pa dam par gyur pa gle lung mkhan po dkon mchog rin chen dang / bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang po kun spangs chos kyi nyi ma dang / rigs ldan gyi sprul pa rim par byon pa'i gnas mchog jo nang mkhan chen ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa dang / mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa srin po ri mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog dang / rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa la bslab sbyangs mthar phyin pa gro sa mkhan chen nam mkha' dbang phyug dang / mdo sngags kyi lung yongs su rdzogs pa stag lung mkhan po bkra shis dpal 'byor dang / gsung rab mang po'i don la blo gros kyis 'jug pa rab tu rgyas pa gser mdog pa gzhon nu nor bzang snying po dang /

rig grol gyi yon tan du ma la dbang 'byor ba spa spong chos rje dge 'dun dpal bzang dang / tha snyad kyi rigs gnas mtha' dag 'chad pa dang rtsom pa la blo gros kyi snang ba thob pa skyer lo tsā ba ngag dbang bkra shis dpal bzang po la sogs pa mkhas grub kyi slob ma mtshan nas bgrang du gtub pa brgya phrag du ma bzhugs shing / gzhan yang gdan sa chen po'i brgya dpon dang zur chos pa bstan pa la bya ba mdzad nus pa du ma dang / dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi chos sde chen po'i mkhan po dang / dgon pa so so'i bla ma dang / grwa tshang tha dad kyi slob dpon dang / blo gsal du ma'i 'dren pa dang / mi chen mang po'i bla ma la sogs pa bdag nyid chen po dngos kyi slob ma bstan pa rin po che'i gsal byed dam pa du ma zhig bzhugs pa de dag thams cad la bdag dad cing gus mod kyi/ mtshan rnams ni yi ge mang pas 'jigs nas 'bri bar ma nus so/ /mdor na bdag nyid chen po dang dus dang gnas kyis ya bskal zhing / chos lugs gzhan gyi dbang du gyur pa ma yin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal mo che zhig gi rang rang gi skal ba dang mtshams pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi thob par byas nas/ dad pa'i dbang po rnam par rgyas pas rigs kyi cod paṇa dam par 'dzin cing / sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa'i rjes su slob par mdzad pa bgrang ba las 'das pas kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad cing / de dag gi slob ma dang yang slob nying slob rnams kyis kyang rgya mtsho'i gos can la ches shin tu ngal ba byas pa yin no/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/ ting 'dzin klu dbang du mas nyer bsten pa'i/ /gting mtha' mi mngon chos dbyings thugs mtsho las/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i chu chen rab phab nas/ /bstan 'dzin rtsa ljang myu gu mang du bskyed/ /e ma 'jam mgon gnyis pa'i zhal gyi lung / /rna ba'i kun dgar mi 'dzin mkhas pa su/ /khyed kyi zhabs sen yid 'ong nor bu'i phreng /

/spyi bo'i rgyan du mi len chen po gang / /rang gi slob ma rang dang rjes mthun pa/ /mkhas btsun bzang po mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum/ /mdzad nus du ma'i mdzad pa bsam yas kyis/ /blo gsal rnams kyi blo mtsho 'gengs la rtsen// //gnyis pa btsun pa'i yon tan ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang po nyer zhi zhing / /bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i lhag bsam can/ /zab gsal rdo rje gsum gyi rnam rol gyis/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyams len du mas dges/ /zhes te/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni sku'i skye ba mang por goms pa'i shugs kyis rang bzhin gyis dul zhing brtan pas kha na ma tho ba cung zad kyang mi mdzad la/ khyad par du legs par gsung ba'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad tshun chad bcas rang gi nyes pa phra mo tsam yang khyad du mi gsod cing / tshul 'chos la sogs pa'i dri ma tsam yang mi mnga' bar btsun pa brtan pa'i yon tan dang / mkhas shing phan 'dogs kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan zhing / gzhan bsnyen par rdzogs pa brgya phrag mang po'i mkhan po mdzad cing / dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyis bslab par bya ba phra zhing phra ba rnams la'ang blang dor tshul bzhin du mdzad pas/ nyes par snang ba'i cha tsam gyis ma gos shing / tha na bzhugs lugs ma mdzes pa'am/ bla gos bzhes tshul ma legs pa tsam yang mi mnga' bas sku gsung thugs shin tu btsun pa'i mchog tu gyur pa 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po rnams dang mtshungs par bzhugs pa yin no/ /yang byang chub kyi thugs rin po che rnam pa gnyis skye ba du mar goms pa'i dbang gis rang chas su mnga' zhing / khyad par du theg chen thun mong ba dbu ma lugs dang / thun mong ma yin pa dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga gnyis la brten pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa mnos phyin chad bslab par bya ba las skad cig kyang nyams par mi mnga' zhing / pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang /

bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas bstan pa rin po che'i bya ba kho na dang / mtha' yas pa'i sems can la phan dang bde ba'i thabs 'ba' zhig mdzad pa las/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi ro myang ba'i rang don gyi 'khris dang bcas pa'i mdzad pa gzhan ci yang mi snang ba'i phyir bdag pas gzhan gces par 'dzin pa'i snying rje chen po'i ros thugs brgyud yongs su gang ba'i sems dpa' chen po yin no/ /gzhan yang zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po rnams su zhugs te rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa thob phyin chad rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes ltung gi dri mas nam yang ma gos shing / lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba dam tshig dang sdom pa gnyis yin par dgongs nas/ mnyam rjes dang bza' bsrung dang mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig zab mo rnams la nan tan du mdzad cing / de'i ngang nas bstan pa'i bya ba thos pa dang sgom pa rim gyis chos la gnas pa yin gyis/ sbyor ba gang rung ba tsam gyis ma yin zhing / thos pa dang bsam pa la ma brten par bsgom pa 'ba' zhig la zhugs pa de yang chos la gnas pa ma yin par dgongs nas/ mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu byon pa'i chos thams cad bsam byung gi rig pas sgro 'dogs legs par bcad de/ zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin la bcud len mdzad pa'i phyir du gzhan dang mi mnyam pa'i brtson 'grus dang brtul ba drag pos/ nyin zhag phrugs re la bcom ldan 'das dges mdzad rdo rje'i phyi nang sbrags pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa blang ba dang bcas pa/ dril bu zhabs kyis bkral ba'i bde mchog gi lus dkyil/ nag po pa'i lugs kyi mngon rtogs/ rdo rje phur pa'i mngon rtogs/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bla ma rin 'byung / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bsrung ba gnyis/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi nyams len/ 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag dang bcas pa/ bde mchog dkar po'i nyams len/ rdo rje lha mo'i mngon rtogs/

dmar po skor gsum gyi nyams len/ sgrol dkar gyi mngon rtogs/ thub pa me rlung di ṣa ra/ rnam rgyal 'joms gnyis/ mgon po'i bsrung zlog rgyas pa la sogs pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor re re nas kyang sngags kyi bzlas pa grangs mang po dang bcas pa thun gnyis dang gsum bzhi la sogs pa'i nges pa gtan mi 'chag pa'i dam bca' brtan po mdzad cing / gtso cher rdzogs rim gyi nyams len zab mo lta ba skyong ba dang bcas pa du ma dang / sbyor drug gi nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor dang / rlung dang 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor du mas mtshan mo'i cha phal cher 'da' bar mdzad la/ snga dro thugs dam grol nas rten gsum rnams la phyag dang bcas pa'i yan lag bdun pa dang / dkar gtor cha bzhi/ nyin bar gyi dus su tshogs chos gsung ba la sogs pa'i lung dang bshad pa dang / phyag khrid rnams mdzad/ de lta bu mi gnang ba'i dus su phyag dpe'i gzigs rtog kho na mdzad la/ thun mtshams gang rigs la gtor ma brgya rtsa rgyas pa chu sbyin dang bcas pa/ dzaṃ ser nag dbyug gu ma dpun gsum/ dus 'khor gyi bsrung ma drug cu/ thugs rje chen po'i brul gtor/ cha gsum gtor ma rnams mdzad nas/ mthar shes rab snying po saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du tshar gsum bdud zlog bsngo ba smon lam dang bcas pa mdzad/ bar skabs gang rigs la sku 'chag pa'i zhabs bskor dang bcas te rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam bzhi dang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bstod pa du ma dang / brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha yar/ dpa' bos mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstod tshogs 'ga' yar/ dpal ldan chos skyong grags kyi mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi bstod pa rgyun chags/ tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs phyogs bcu ma/ thams cad mkhyen pa bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrol ma'i bstod pa me tog phreng 'dzin la sogs pa'i rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis mdzad pa'i chos spyod kyi tshogs mang du mdzad/

dgong mo'i dus su dbang dang byin rlabs dang rjes gnang zab mo rnams so so'i blo dang mtshams par mdzad/ de nas srod thun phal cher rdzogs pa'i 'jug tu/ bde dges phur gsum/ mgon po lha brgyad/ gdong bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ dkar bdud lcam dral/ phur srung dam can/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rnams rgyas par phul nas bzlas pa cung zad re mdzad de/ thun gtor gzims khang gi steng du skyong bar mdzad/ de nas srod thun gyi 'phro rnams rdzogs nas tho rangs kyi cha ma zin tsam la sku khams bso ba'i mnal gyi rnal 'byor cung zad re mdzad de/ de lta bus nyin mtshan khor yug 'da' ba las sku gsung thugs tha mal du bzhugs pa nam yang mi srid do/ /mdor na bdag nyid chen po 'di nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi mnyam gzhag gi thugs dam zab mo rnams lta zhog chos spyod dang gtor ma'i bsgrigs chag tsam yang deng sang dge ba la rtse gcig bzhugs par rloms pa rnams kyis nyin zhag du mar 'bad kyang grub pa dka' bar mthong cing / gdul bya so so'i blo dang mtshams par chos gsung ba dang / 'bel gtam mdzad pa dang / thun mtshams rnams su rgya bod kyi gsung rab rab 'byams kyi zhal phye ste gzigs rtog mdzad pa la lteng 'grus cung zad kyang mi mnga' ba 'di lta bu ni bstan pa'i khur bzhes par grags pa'i klog pa'ang su zhig la'ang 'dug pa mthong ba'am thos pa med do/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/ khyed thugs dag pa'i nam mkhar tshigs gsum gyi/ /tshul khrims yar ngo'i cha shas gong 'phel zhing / /nges par 'byung ba'i chu sel las grub pa'i/ /gzhan la mi gnod btsun pa'i 'od dkar can/ /byams dang snying rje'i dkyil 'khor cher rgyas pa'i/ /sems gnyis nyin mor byed pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mun pa dpyis 'byin cing / /phan bde'i lam bzang gsal mdzad skye dgu'i sgron/ /zab don ljon shing dam tshig rtsa ba brtan/ /rim gnyis yal 'dab lag len me tog rgyas/

/zung 'jug 'bras bu'i khur ldan phrin las kyi/ /grib bsil g.yo ldan rig 'dzin dpag bsam shing // //gsum pa bzang po'i yon tan ni/ srid zhi'i phun tshogs kun la dbang bsgyur yang / /chags dang dregs pas ma gos 'grogs na bde/ /mchog la gus shing dman la lhag par byams/ /rnam dkar mdzad pa bsam pas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes te/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni/ rang nyid yon tan thams cad dang ldan zhing / che dgu kun gyi spyi bor bkur yang / rgyags pa dang dregs pa nam yang mi mnga' zhing / mngon par khengs pa'i mdud pa thams cad dkrol te zhi zhing dul la 'jam zhing mnyen pa'i rang bzhin du gnas pas/ skye bo su zhig la yang chas chod pa dang khengs pa'i tshig mi gsung / gzhan la mtho 'tshams pa dang phrag dog gi rnam pa cung zad kyang mi mnga'/ khyad par lta ba dang grub pa mtha' tha dad cing / chos lugs mi gcig pa'i skyes bu dam pa su zhig la'ang dad gus chen po mdzad/ rnam par thar pa legs phyogs 'ba' zhig sgrog pa la/ /gang zag gi skyon nas gsung ba sus kyang thos ma myong / /zhal nas kyang / gang zhig la dag snang sbyongs/ grub mtha' la brtag dpyad gyis bya ba yin/ dad gus 'di mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba gcig byed shes dgos zhes yang yang gsung / bdag nyid kyi rigs kyi cod paṇa du gyur pa'i rdo rje slob dpon rnams la bcos ma ma yin pa'i dad gus chen pos nges par rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bor dgongs shing / zhal bzhugs pa'i dus su rnyed pa bkur bsti dang tshigs su bcad pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gi rnam par thar pa dang rjes su mthun par bsten tshul rnam pa lngas bsten pa dang / mnyes thabs rnam pa bzhis mnyes par mdzad cing / zhi bar gshegs nas kyang dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i thabs dang / dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba la sogs pa la shin tu brtson par mdzad/ yon tan gyis khyad par du byas pa'i sde snod dang /

rgyud sde 'dzin pa chen po rnams la'ang bkur bsti dang bdag gnyer gzhan las che bar mdzad/ tha na dge bshes su ming btags pa tshun chad la yang skabs su bab pa'i zhe sa mdzad/ rtag tu dges shing mdangs gsal la 'dzum zhing bzhad/ skye bo su zhig zhabs drung du lhags na yang / bdag la dges par 'dug snyam pa 'byung zhing 'grogs na bde/ phyi rol tu khros pa kun kyang zhabs drung du sleb pa tsam gyis zhi mal gyis 'gro/ bsod nams cha mthun tsam la gnas pa'i tha lam pa zhig yin na yang / chos dang 'jig rten gyi bka' mchid cung zad byung ba tsam gyis dad cing gus par 'gyur/ rnyed bkur dang che thabs la sogs pa'i don la stsol sgrub gang yang mi mdzad/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis blun po tshe 'dir snang can rnams kyis mi chos la thugs mi gzhol bar byed/ phyag rdzas rnams kyang gzhis ka so so'i gnyer pa dang / sku 'khor rnams kyi gang byed las/ ched gnyer cung zad kyang mi mdzad/ 'phral du byung ba rnams rten gsum bzhengs pa dang / bla ma'i dus mchod/ sku rim du btags pa'i sbyin gtong kho na las/ rang don du til tsam yang mi 'dzin/ 'bul ba dang zhabs tog chen po byas pa la ha cang dges pa'i thugs yang cher mi mdzad cing / ma byas pa la'ang mi dges pa mi mnga'/ chos ldan gyi bya ba gang la'ang thugs ngang ring zhing thugs klong dang thugs skyel che/ dam pa'i chos don gnyer gyi snyoms chung rnams la chos dang 'tsho chas kyi bka' drin stsol/ 'phongs pa dang mgon med pa rnams la byams pa dang snying rjes skyong / mi bsrun zhing ches mi mthun pa dang 'khor dang longs spyod kyis dregs pa rnams la bstun 'jogs mi mdzad/ g.yo sgyu dang zol zog gi dri mas ma gos pas thams cad kyis yid rton pa'i gnas su gyur/ rtag tu lus gnad kyis bzhugs shing cha lugs 'bang dang ldan/ 'dzag pa'i nyes pa dang bral bas sku lus gzhon sha che zhing zhal ras bkrag dang ldan/

sku la sems can dang srin bu la sogs pa srog chags kyi rigs gtan med par kun gyis mthun du grub/ skye bo'i tshogs ji tsam mang ba ci bzhin sku lus gzengs mtho zhing gzi brjid che/ mthong ba tsam gyis skyes bu chen po yin par gdon mi za bar 'tshal bar byed/ nad gdon gyis nyen pa rnams la shin tu brtse ba'i thugs kyis byin rlabs dang ljags chab la sogs pas phan pa sgrub/ char dbab pa dang / rims nad bcad pa sogs la de dang de'i thugs 'dun dang bcas pa'i thabs mdzad pa tsam gyis don de thogs med du 'grub/ dam pa'i chos 'chad pa nyid la bzhugs pa'i tshe dbang lung man ngag gi chos thun rigs mi 'dra ba du ma gsung ba la skyo ba dang dub pa'i rnam pa cung zad kyang mi mdzad cing / chos zhu rnams kyis yun ring du bsgug sdod byas pa la thugs brtse sems chen pos thugs brel dang snga phyi ci la thug kyang gang 'dod pa'i chos kyi bka' drin bstsal/ de lta na'ang thugs dam gyi rim pa rnams la lteng 'grus cung zad kyang med pas/ skabs 'gar thun gtor steng du phul ba na skya rengs shar ba mang du byung zhes gleng zhing / de'i stobs kyis nub ma gnyis gsum tsam mnal ma mdzad kyang sku khams ye mi ldog pa gcig dang po nas goms pa'i shugs kyis yod ces gsung ngo / /zhes drung na gnas pa dag las thos so/ /mdor na bdag nyid chen po 'di'i sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa rmad du byung ba 'di lta bu dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags su bshad de/ bsdud pa tshigs su bcad pa las/ zang zing med par 'gro la chos ni rjes su ston/ /chos la gcig tu dga' zhing rtag tu tshig 'jam ldan/ /'gro 'chag nyal dang 'dug par shes bzhin rab tu ldan/ /gnya' shing gang tsam blta zhing 'gro ba sems 'khrul med/ /gtsang byas gtsang ma'i gos 'chang gsum po dben zhing dag /rnyed 'dod ma yin khyu mchog rtag tu chos 'dod pa/

/bdud kyi yul las 'das shing gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog /bsam gtan bzhi la bsam gtan bsam gtan der mi gnas/ /grags pa 'dod pa ma yin khro bas sems dkris med/ /khyim par gyur na rtag tu dngos po kun ma chags/ /'tsho ba'i phyir ni ya ngas longs spyod tshol mi byed/ /drag shul sbyor sngags mi byed bud med sbyor bsngags min/ /'dod pa'i las can pho mor 'gyur zhes ston mi byed/ /rab tu dben pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin mchog brtson/ /'thab dang rtsod dang bral zhing byams pa'i sems dang ldan/ /kun mkhyen 'dod cing bstan la rtag tu gzhol sems ldan/ /mtha' 'khob kla klo skye bo'i yul mtha' rnam par spangs/ /rang gi lta la dogs med rtag tu ri rab 'dra/ /chos phyir sreg kyang 'dor zhing rnal 'byor rab tu brtson/ /mi ldog rtags ni 'di dag yin par shes par bya/ /zhes gang bka' stsal pa 'di dag bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs mi'i gzugs can 'di la ma tshang ba med par mnga' ba yin no// //de dag la 'di skad ces/ bgrang yas yon tan kun gyis rtser 'dzegs kyang / /mngon par khengs pa'i mdung gi ba dan brnyal/ /skye dgu kun gyis gtsug gis rab btud kyang / /kun gyi 'bangs ltar gzhan gyi don la dges/ /spyod lam kun tu zhi zhing dul ba'i thugs/ /grogs dan sdug bsngal drag mo thos mi skrag /skad cig nyon mongs go skabs g.yo min pa'i/ /mchog tu zhi bas kun gyi khro ba'ang 'joms/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed la sogs mgo snyoms shing / /mgon dang mgon med rgud pa kun las 'dzin/ /dam bcas phrin las ngang gis lhur mdzad cing / /rtag tu 'dren pa kun gyi dran du bzhugs/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong rdo rje lta bu'i sku/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu chos char 'bebs pa'i gsung / /snying rjes gzhan dbang gyur pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /khyod kyi mdzad pa byis blo'i yul las 'das/ /e ma bdag ni tshul 'di mthong bas kyang /

/skyon med rnam par thar pa bsam yas kyis/ /mgon khyod gzhan las bzang por sgrub yin te/ /phyogs 'di ngos nas su ldang mchi ma g.yo/ /de ltar dgung lo bcu gcig nas brtsams te bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa chu bo 'brug gi lo ma rdzogs kyi bar du bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam bsgom gsum dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod brtsom gsum yel mar mdzad pas thugs shin tu rang bar gyur cing / snyigs ma'i dus kyi skye bo rnams kyi spyod tshul ngan pa dag gzigs pas thugs cung zad gdung bar yang gyur nas/ zhing khams dag pa gzhan du gshegs pa la thugs mngon du phyogs par gyur te/ de'i snga ltas su sa'i dkyil 'khor 'di yang khol bur g.yos/ tho rangs kyi dus su du ba 'jug rings lta bu'i skar ma mjug phod dang bcas pa gcig kyang shar/ skye bo rnams kyang yid mi bde zhing 'khrugs par gyur/ phyogs kyi mo brtsis pa rnams kyis kyang 'gro ba mang po'i 'dren pa dam pa zhig la dog cing / de'i nang nas kyang bdag nyid chen po la sku dog shin tu che zer ba 'ga' zhig byung ba/ sems yed yed por gyur nas/ bdag gis ding sang mtshan ltas la sogs pa ji ltar byung / phyid lo 'di dgung stengs yin pas sku dog bzhin ni med lags sam zhes zhus pas/ ding sang rmi ltas la sogs pa gang yang ma byung / kha sing snga gong za zing gzhan kha gcig byung ba/ glo bor mkhan chen chos kyi rje zhing gzhan du gshegs pa la lta ba yin nam snyam pa zhig byung ste da kha rkyang pa'ang min pa 'dra/ phyid lo 'di la dog cha cung zad yod nyen ka che zhes gsung / 'o na de la dmigs pa'i sku rim dang sku mtshams sogs mdzad nas yun ring du zhabs brtan pa'i rten 'brel gnang dgos zhus pas/ rim gro sogs sngar yang gang grub byas/ da rung rim par byed rtsis yin/ mtshams dam pa zhig byed bsam na'ang / kha sang nas chos 'chad pa dang ding sang gdan sa pa 'di rnams bde 'jags gcig yong re nas 'gyangs pa yin/

'di tsho'i brel ba chod 'phral la mtshams byed ces gsung / de dus ni bka' lung de sgra ji bzhin pa yin par byas na'ang / phyis bde ba can gyi zhing khams kyi gzigs snang byung ba la sogs pa dang sgo bstun na/ rang nyid blun pa dang rtag 'dzin ches pas ma go ba ma gtogs/ zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa mkhyen cing dgongs pa'i bka' lung kho nar gnang zhing / spyir yang bdag nyid chen po 'di phra rags kyi bya ba dang phrin las gang bsgrub na'ang thugs ngang shin tu ring ba zhig yin pa la/ de lo gsol ba btab cing zhal gyis bzhes pa'i gsung chos thams cad ma grub dogs pa lta bu'i thugs stsol chen po mdzad nas gnang ba dang / gdan sa pa spyi'i mdun 'jags dang / gzims khang gi zhig gsos kyang gang myur myur gyis zhes yang yang bka' phebs pa la sogs pa la rjes su dpags na/ ltos bcas kyi gdul ba rnams la thugs brtse bas de bar zhabs brtan par bzhugs pa ma gtogs bde ba can du gshegs pa'i thugs mdun snga gong nyid nas mdzad zin par mngon no/ /de nas sbrul lo zla ba dang po'i tshes nyi shu skor la rin chen sgang gzims khang du phebs nas sku mtshams bug sgo can mdzad de/ thugs dam zab mo la rtse gcig tu bzhugs shing / thun mtshams la gsung rtsom 'phro can rnams kyang grub par mdzad/ zla ba lnga pa'i nyer bzhi lnga tsam gzhan ngor zhabs cung zad bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan te/ gdan sa chen por sku rim rgyun ldan du bsgrubs shing / gtsang phyogs kyi grwa dgon so sor yang sku rim gyi mang ja btang kyang sku khams la bskyed du mngon pa ma byung bas/ tshes lnga nas bug sgo phye ste gdung brgyud rin po che'ang phyag phyir bzhugs/ slar yang chos sde grags pa can phal cher du sku rim stobs che bar btang zhing / gdan sa chen po la gtogs pa'i spyi sgos thams cad kyis kyang rang sa nas dad gus chen pos sku rim bsgrubs/ sku khams cung zad nyog pa las sku la bsnyung zug la sogs pa gang yang med pas/

dus skabs phal che ba thugs dam zab mo la rtse gcig tu bzhugs shing / skabs 'gar la 'dug sar mchod pa gsar pa bshoms zhes yang yang gsung / de dag gi skabs thams cad du nam mkha' bai ḍūr+ya'i mdog ltar shin tu snum zhing dwang pa la nyi ma'i 'od zer sngar bas kyang lhag par gsal zhing / lha'i me tog gi char bsam gyis mi khyab pa babs pas sku 'khor rnams yid ma bde nas/ 'di ltar 'dug lags pas ci 'dra lags zhus pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa la la sku bltams pa dang / la la mya ngan las 'da' ba la sogs pa'i tshul ston pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pas de kun gyi ltas yin mod/ ces gsung zhing gzhan gyi sems bsrung ba'i phyir du yal yol mdzad/ tshes bcu'i snga dro'i dus da lta sku khams gso ba'i mnal cung zad gcig mdzad na nyin mo sku khams dwang pa yongs lags sam zhus pas/ de tsam 'dug long med ces gsung / de ltar zla ba phyed kyi bar du sku rim dang gsol sman la sogs pa'i thabs du ma zhig phul yang / zhing khams 'di'i mdzad pa re zhig rdzogs pa dang / zhing khams gzhan du gdul bya rgya che ba la dgongs nas/ rtag 'dzin can rnams nges 'byung bskyed pa dang / le lo can rnams brtson 'grus la bskul bar bya ba'i ched du/ chos kyi rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mig 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi skyabs dam pa de nyid/ dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa dgur phebs pa chu mo sbrul gyi lo/ chu stod kyi zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshe bcu'i nyi ma dro bar tsam na sku g.yas ngos su cung zad yo tsam pa'i ngang nas/ nyi zla'i rlung dhu ti'i nang du bsdus te gzugs kyi sku'i bkod pa bsdus nas rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid dang / mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po ro mnyam pa'i 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshul bstan to/

/de nas sku 'khor du gnas pa'i dpon g.yog rnams mgron po phyogs bslad pa ltar ci ltar bya ba gtol med par gyur nas/ bzlog par dka' ba'i mya ngan gyi me drag pos kun nas gdung bzhin du de nyid du yun ring du bzhugs pas/ phyi dro'i cha la bab pa na thams cad kyis gsan pa'i thag sgra shin tu che ba dang bcas te dbu'i gtsug gi thod pa sor gang tsam zhig gtsug tor gyi tshul du 'phag pa la byang sems kyi zil pa phro le ba dang bcas par gyur cing / de ma thag nas sngar su zhig gi'ang sna'i yul du tshor ma myong ba'i lha rdzas kyi spos kyi dri bsung khyad par can gyis gzims khang gi steng 'og thams cad khyab pa dang / kha dog sna tshogs pa'i 'ja' tshon gyi ri mo mdzes pa'i nam mkha' las me tog gi char chen po 'bab pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te/ rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas 'byung ba'i 'da' kha ma zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyis bde ba can gyi zhing khams su lha dang lha mo rnams kyis mngon par bshams pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis zhabs 'bring byas nas gshegs te rgyal ba thams cad kyi mdzad pa dus gcig tu bsdus par gyur to/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/ kye ma kyi hud 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje/ /bsnyun bral sprul sku bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan nas/ /'pho med thugs tshud 'pho ba'i ngang tshul gyis/ /dus kyi nges pa dang bcas dus mthar bzhugs/ /kyi hur 'jig rten stongs so chos kyi rje/ /yid bzhin nor bu rnyed nas glo bur stor/ /dad can skye bo thams cad mig dang bral/ /de ring 'jig rten thams cad mun par song / /rigs gzugs phun tshogs tshul khrims lus zungs rgyas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba kun mkhyen pa'i/ /mang thos gang de lang tsho ma yol par/ /bstan pa'i bya ba bshol nas gang du gshegs/ /bgrang yas blo gsal rgyu skar phreng ba yis/

/khor yug mdzes pa'i kun gsal chos kyi grwar/ /gzhung brgya 'chad pa'i snang ba mi stsol bar/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i zla ba ci slad gshegs/ /yang dag lung gi rta bdun dang 'grogs pa'i/ /rig pa'i 'od zer bye ba rab bkye nas/ /log lta'i mun pa stug po dpyis 'byin pa'i/ /bsnyings bral bstan pa'i nyi ma nub rir yol/ /mtha' yas 'gro la bu gcig ltar dgongs shing / /byams dang snying rje dam dbang gyur pa khyod/ /da dung 'gro ba'i don yang ma rdzogs na/ /mgon med bdag cag 'bor ba 'di phod dam/ /khyod kyi sngon chad 'gro 'di bde bar bskyangs/ /da ni khyod dang bral ba'i mya ngan gyi/ /zug rngu drag pos lus sems sdug bsngal ba'i/ /khur 'di thar 'dod rnams kyi steng du lhung / /snang ba lha dang 'khor lo'i rnam rol te/ /de yang bde stong mchog gi rang bzhin zhes/ /mgon po khyod kyi bdag la bka' bstsal na/ /nyams thag sdug bsngal 'di 'dra ci slad stsol/ /kye ma zla ba las ni bsreg za dang / /tsan dan las ni ha la'i me tog ltar/ /bden gsung khyod kyang 'khyog po lhur mdzad na/ /kyi hud bslu med skyabs zhig gang nas 'tshol/ /kun gyi mig la bdud rtsi stsol mkhas pa'i/ /grangs med bsod nams phung po 'dus pa'i dngos/ /yid 'phrog rdo rje'i sku yang gzhan yin na/ /skye bo bden pa'i yid brtan su la bgyi/ /dad pas khyod kyi zhabs drung gnas byas nas/ /'dzum zhal yang yang blta bas ma ngoms pa/ /da ni yud tsam mthong ba'i skabs phral ba'i/ /bdag gi mig gi bsod nams gang du song / /rgyud lung man ngag phyogs re'i snang ba can/ /bshes gnyen rgyu skar 'char nub mang na yang / /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i gling bzhi gsal nus pa'i/ /smra ba'i nyi ma nub po chos kyi rje/ /rgya chen chos kyi mdzad pas thugs drangs nas/ /yang yang phyag gi zur phud legs bkod pa'i/ /rigs gnas kun dang mdo dang rgyud sde bzhi'i/

/glegs bam tshogs rnams grogs med skyo ba 'phel/ /zab don bla ma'i zhal la rag las pa'i/ /rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas su yis 'byed/ /sgra dang snyan ngag sdeb sbyor su la 'dri/ /dus 'khor phyi nang gzhan gsum gang nas btsal/ /legs sbyar lha yi skad du chos ston pa/ /'di ni bdag cag lha yi bla ma zhes/ /lha bu rnams kyis me tog gis bsus te/ /snum gtsang lha yi lam nas yud kyis gshegs/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan nyams dus 'dir/ /chos kyi chab srid skyong bar mi mdzad par/ /'ja' 'od shing rta chibs nas khyod gshegs pa/ /'di bas ji snyam gzhan zhig gzigs lags grangs/ /bgrang yas yon tan du mas mdzes pa'i sku/ /'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya ston pa'i gsung / /mtho dman kun la brtse ba'i thugs mnga' khyod/ /da ni dran pa tsam gyi yul du gyur/ /'on kyang khyod sku gang la gang 'dul te/ /gsung yang de der mtshams pa'i dam chos ston/ /khyod thugs skye 'gag med pa nam mkha'i ngang / /yin phyir dam pa'i don du gshegs bzhud bral/ /kun rdzob bla ma sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /don dam bla ma 'khor 'das kun la khyab/ /rang rig bla ma rang sems gdod ma'i mgon/ /yin zhes khyod kyi gsung rab de skad gleng / /snying dbus ze 'brur rtag bzhugs rje btsun che/ /gang gi rigs kyi cod paṇa dang bcas pa/ /bdag gi tshe rabs kun gyi 'dren pa ste/ /da dung byang chub bar du thugs rjes skyongs/ /de nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po 'phags pa dpal ldan bkra shis pas phyag len mdzad nas/ rgyud sde zab mo nas bshad pa'i cho gas sku gdung rin po che la chas gzhug gi zhabs tog phul te/ spos dang dar zab la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang / na bza'i tshogs du mas bkur bsti chen po byas nas/ gzims khang de nyid du rnam rgyal mchod rten rin po che gser gyis spras pa shin tu mdzes pa zhig bzhengs te 'gro ba mang po'i bsod nams kyi zhing dam par re shig bzhugs su gsol zhing /

thugs dam gsal 'debs su bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog grub chen nag po pa'i lugs kyi sgrub mchod nar mar phul lo/ /de ltar de dag gi skabs thams cad du yang nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pa la lha rdzas kyi me tog gi char zhag grangs du ma'i bar du bab cing / khyad par gzims khang gi steng dang nye logs kun tu thus pas chog pa'i me tog gi char chen po babs pas sa phyogs tha dad na bzhugs pa'i zhal ngo rnams la ji ltar bya ba'i bka' bgros zhu ba'i slad du re shig gsang ba'i dam tshig byas kyang / rtog dpyod che ba rnams kyis ngo mtshar ba'i ltas rnams la rjes su dpags nas zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa go ba yang mang du byung bar mngon no/ /de nas dus re shig na bla brang ma nas gzhi bzung zhing zhal ngo dang dpon chen dang phyogs rigs kyi sbyin bdag dang / sku 'khor du gtogs pa'i sbyin bdag dad pa can thams cad kyis kyang ma bskul bzhin du tha dad nas rang rang gi dad gus chen pos gang la gang bab kyi yo byad rgya chen po sbyar te zhag grangs du ma'i bar du gdan sa chen po'i tshogs chen/ phyogs ris nas byon pa'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa la bsnyen bkur 'bul 'gyed gya nom pa bsgrubs shing / sku gdung rin po che'i drung du rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu phrag gcig gis 'khor lo bde mchog gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas sgrub mchod yun ring du phul te thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad la/ de nas kyang zla dus kyi mang ja la sogs pa spyi sgos so so nas dad pa chen pos dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba la brtson par mdzad cing / gzims mal gyi sku tshab tu/ bdag nyid chen po'i sku 'dra rin po che gser zangs las grub pa mda' gang tsam zhig bzhengs/ rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i gzungs bzhugs la sogs pa legs par grub nas/ rgyal ba zhes pa shing pho rta'i lo mgo'i zla ba'i yar tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin/

bdag chen rin po che ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi gtso mdzad/ bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po du mas rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rgyas par mdzad de/ bkra shis dang rab gnas kyi gzi 'od rab tu 'bar bar bzhugs shing / de nas kyang srid pa ji srid du rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgyu ma lta bu las byung ba'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rim par byon te gdul bya gang la ci 'dul gyi rnam par bstan nas phrin las kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad cing lhun gyis grub par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de ltar yang dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud las/ de ltar rigs kyi bu 'di ltar/ khyad par du ma rmi lam lta bur sangs rgyas kyi rol pa mchog tu ston par mdzad do/ /gang zhig sgrub pa sgyu ma'i tshul gyis 'gro ba thams cad kyi don mdzad do zhes dang / mgon po byams pas kyang / gang gi srid pa ji srid par/ /'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag /mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi chad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma'i sku/ /dmigs med thugs rje'i shing rtas rab drangs nas/ /mtshungs bral gnas lnga rig pa'i skur bstan pa/ /'dren pa gang der slar yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi yon tan bkod pa'i gtam/ /sprin bral nyi ma gzhon nu ltar gsal ba/ /blo mig dag pa'i mkha' la rab spros pas/ /skul byed zhal gyi pad+mo 'dzum pa snyam/ /'jam mgon gnyis pa'i mkhyen brtse'i zlos gar ni/ /blta 'dod yul dang dus kyi bskal pa dag /sdebs legs rnam thar me long 'di ltos dang / /mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan ngang gis 'char/ /yid bzhin nor bu spangs nas mching bu la/ /mkhas kun dges pa'i rgyan bzang bya'o zhes/

/ltar snang phreng du dngar ba'i skal chung po/ /de dag rdzun tshig sbyor dang 'di mi 'dra/ /gang zhig mthong bas mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog cing / /legs par bsten na bslu med nges pa skye/ /tshur rol mthong bas bsam pa'i yul min pa'i/ /rnam thar rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs bla na med/ /mdor na khyod kyi mkhyen rab kun gsal khyon/ /dri med thugs rje'i 'od dkar ke la sha/ /mdzad pa rnam dkar rnyog bral shī ta'i rgyun/ /snyan grags dri bsung ma la ya rlung ngo / /'jam dbyangs nyid mtshungs khyod kyi yon tan cha/ /bdag 'dras bskal par brjod par mi nus mod/ /'on kyang dad dang spro ba'i dbang song nas/ /cung zad brjod la mchog tu dwangs ba skye/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing / /yid gnyis spangs te mchod pa kun gyis mchod/ /sgo gsum nyes pa'i tshogs kun so sor bshags/ /'phags bzhi so skye'i dge la rjes yi rang / /gnas lnga'i chos 'khor rtag tu skor bar bskul/ /rigs drug 'gro ba'i mgon du rtag bzhugs zhes/ /nor bdun ldan pa'i 'jam dbyangs bla ma la/ /chos brgyad g.yo zol min par gsol ba 'debs/ /sa dgus bsdus pa'i mtha' yas 'gro ba rnams/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phangs ma thob bar/ /mgon po khyod kyi byams brtse'i phyag zung gis/ /srid zhi'i rgyud pa kun las drang du gsol/ /de skad gcam bu'i ngo bstod ma yin par/ /don mthun grogs dang grogs bcas ji bzhin du/ /dung dung gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes 'brang bdag /da nas bzung ste thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung / /gus pas bstod cing gsol ba btab pa las/ /las dkar bsags pa gang de 'gro ba kun/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i rjes 'gro zhing / /zhing 'dir phan bde'i 'byor pa thob par shog /'gro kun dga' byed bsod nams bye ba'i gter/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan can des gangs can 'di/ /dpal ldan skal ba bzang por mdzad pa'i tshul/

/mdo tsam bshad 'di mkhas rnams mnyes gyur cig/ //ces mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes snyan pa'i gdugs dkar srid pa gsum na gsal ba de'i rnam par thar pa yon tan gyi rgya mtsho chen po las/ dad pa'i sor mos chu thigs tsam zhig blangs te yi ger bkod pa 'di ni/ thog mar bdag nyid chen po la mi phyed pa'i dad gus chen pos phu dud du mdzad pa'i mi'i dbang phyug dam pa nam mkha' don grub pa'i bkas yang yang bskul zhing / bar du blo gsal don gnyer can du mas bskul ba dang / tha mar gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kun mkhyen shes rab 'od zer ba'i gsung 'phrin nan chen pos bskul ba la brten nas/ mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid rigs kyi cod paṇa dang bcas pa las/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin tshad med pa thob pas 'dud las kyi mi phyed pa'i dad pa rgya mtsho'i dbus na gnas pa/ shākya'i dge slong dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgongs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan nas lo gsum stong drug brgya dang drug cu rtsa bdun 'das shing / dus kyi 'khor lo'i byed rtsis me mkha' rgya mtsho dag pa'i lo gzhir bzhag nas/ lo bdun brgya nyi shu rtsa dgu 'das pa/ myos byed ces pa shing mo lug gi lo/ khrums kyi zla ba'i nyer lnga'i nyin/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas su legs par sbyar ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la/ bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig shin tu gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar can mang du snang mod/ bdag gis thun mong du 'bri bar ma nus so// //maṅga laṃ//
